One of the most shameful parts about this is that Governor Greg Abbott announced that he added mid-decade redistricting to the agenda on July 9th — just two days after deadly flooding devastated parts of the state, in the middle of recovery efforts and amidst communities searching for loved ones.
Folks, it’s moments like these that this batch of Republicans are showing their true colors. Communities in Texas needed their governor to lead in a moment of tragedy and crisis. **Instead, he prioritized a partisan scheme to cling to unearned power.**
Keep in mind: The current map is already being challenged by voters because it violates the Voting Rights Act with a clear-cut racial gerrymander. Now, the state wants to double down on this illegal map — seizing an opportunity to manipulate maps even further in a blatant power grab simply because they cannot win fairly. And now, they could manufacture power for themselves **for years to come** in the upcoming special session in Texas, coming up in a matter of days.
[**We, the American people, still control our fate — and with the stakes so high, we cannot allow ourselves to be resigned or tired. clean_body: The Republican agenda is deeply unpopular. So they’re trying to cheat to win instead. | | | Shameful. Just shameful... Team, Republicans are conspiring right now to steal the 2026 midterm elections. They know how unpopular their agenda is, especially after passing a budget bill that will hurt millions of families. So Donald Trump has demanded that Texas Republicans call a special session to design a further gerrymandered map — in the hopes that it could net them four or five seats next fall. I’ll be frank: If the GOP is able to remain in power despite the will of the people, it will be an outrageous violation of our democracy. Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress are afraid of voters who are rightfully furious with their far-right agenda. Instead of changing the way they govern, they’re deciding to cheat instead — manipulating district lines to cling to illegitimate power. And that's not democracy. That’s a return to the darkest chapters of Jim Crow-era voter suppression. At the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, we’re working tirelessly in Texas and around the country alongside Fair Fight to end gerrymandering by electing fair maps champions, advancing redistricting reform, and growing a grassroots movement for free and fair elections. Folks, it’s moments like these that this batch of Republicans are showing their true colors. Communities in Texas needed their governor to lead in a moment of tragedy and crisis. Instead, he prioritized a partisan scheme to cling to unearned power. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|

| **Dear Peter,****Tomorrow marks 60 years since Medicare and Medicaid were signed into law**—two of the most life-saving, dignity-affirming programs this country ever created.**These programs aren’t just policy—they’re lifelines.** For older Americans. For low-income families. For disabled people. For anyone who’s ever needed care without a six-figure bank account.But now they are under attack. Instead of building on 60 years of progress, Donald Trump and his MAGA enablers are working to dismantle the very programs that have helped shape modern America. They’ve slashed Medicaid, undermined Medicare, and expanded privatized schemes that put profits over people.**And Brad Sherman? After nearly 30 years in Congress, he’s not fighting back.** He’s staying silent, while billion-dollar insurers and Trump-aligned corporations gear up to turn Medicare and Medicaid into Wall Street cash cows. **We need leaders who will** _**fight like hell**_**to protect and strengthen Medicare and Medicaid, not stand by while they’re gutted.** But Brad Sherman is doing exactly that. He’s sitting on the sidelines while Medicare is privatized and providers in our district struggle with inadequate reimbursements. He’s avoiding conflict. Playing it safe. Staying quiet—again.**I'm not running to play it safe. I'm running to** _**lead.**_**In Congress, I’ll fight to:**
* **Protect Medicare from privatization and expand its coverage—including dental, vision, and hearing
**
* **Ensure Medicaid is fully funded and accessible for everyone who needs it
**
* **Champion a path to Medicare for All, where care is a right—not a privilege
**

Because we know what’s possible. We’ve seen it. **Medicare and Medicaid are proof.****Let’s defend that legacy—and build on it.**[**Will you chip in $27, $54, or whatever feels right to help us fight back against Trump’s agenda and elect a real defender of healthcare in CD-32?**](https://chrisahuja.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=97f443092fb7c091746070aa0&id=3f7bc3025f&e=5a6ee82cdb) Let’s Go!**Chris Ahuja** **Democratic Candidate for Congress, CD-32**

# We need to stay focused on local races.

# Change happens at the local level. We have races [across the Upstat](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=cc15712a86&e=edbde6c9b1)e that can bolster new leadership, elect servant leaders to office, and give people a voice in government. In Greenville we have Councilwoman [Lillian Brock Flemming ](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=e46b375838&e=edbde6c9b1)defending her seat and T[ina Belge](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=8ed399246d&e=edbde6c9b1) running to protect the democratic majority on Greenville City Council. body:
CBS is canceling Colbert. We’re fighting back with 300,000 voices.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250729-1&t=1&akid=2453%2E587540%2EDqYUOG)
Hey Peter,
If you caught _The Daily Show_ this week, you saw it. Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert weren’t just funny. They were fired up.
Stewart called it out: CBS is trying to cancel Colbert while pushing through an $8 billion corporate merger. And they’re cozying up to Trump to do it.
> _“This isn’t just about a show being canceled. It’s the fear and pre-compliance gripping American institutions... unwilling to stand up to a wannabe dictator.”_
> – Jon Stewart, Monday night
That’s why we’re stepping in. Over **250,000 people have signed** the petition to Save Colbert. Tomorrow, we’re delivering it directly to CBS headquarters in New York. With your help, we can hit **300,000 signatures** before we get there.
**[👉 Sign the petition to Save Colbert](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2033?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fem_ms_lwd_20250729_1_colbert_aa%3Frefcode%3Dem20250729-2453&t=2&akid=2453%2E587540%2EDqYUOG)**
**[Add Your Name Now »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2033?redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fem_ms_lwd_20250729_1_colbert_aa%3Frefcode%3Dem20250729-2453&t=3&akid=2453%2E587540%2EDqYUOG)**
**This isn’t just about late-night TV. It’s about whether we let billionaire corporations silence truth-tellers in order to protect their profits and political access.**
Colbert and Stewart are doing their part. So are leaders like Katie Porter, Ro Khanna, Ted Lieu, and Mark Pocan. So are stars from _Veep_ and _The Daily Show._ They’ve all backed the petition. **Now it’s on us.**
**_We’ve been hand-delivering your signatures to CBS to make sure they’re received._**

body:
I’m ready to serve again.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250729_3_split?amount=5&refcode=em20250729-3479&refcode2=3479_400544_sQF_UB&akid=3479%2E400544%2EsQF_UB)
Hello,
**I’m Roy Cooper, and I am running to be the next U.S. Senator from North Carolina. I believe that our brightest days are still ahead, but we have to work together to fix what’s broken in Washington.**
Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**
**[We have to change things, but I need you with me. Together, we can win this Senate race and help Democrats take back the majority. Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Deb Haaland to get us started off strong?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250729_3_split?amount=20&refcode=em20250729-3479&refcode2=3479_400544_sQF_UB&akid=3479%2E400544%2EsQF_UB)**

**These are no ordinary times.** I believe elected leaders should work to create safety, prosperity and opportunity for every American. Republicans in Washington don’t seem to share that sense of duty.
When I look at what’s happening in Washington now, lawmakers are tearing down our middle class to put even more money in billionaires’ pockets. They’re cutting critical jobs at agencies that help keep our country running. Not even our National Parks or Weather Service are safe.
_They’re punching down — attacking the most vulnerable among us — to make themselves seem strong. Something has to give._
There's another path. When I was Governor of North Carolina, we _expanded_ Medicaid. We passed pay raises for public school teachers and we built a strong economy by investing in clean energy and investing in our people.
_Washington can look like this, too._ It’s time to elect leaders who are ready to do the hard work of strengthening our middle class, restoring voting rights and reproductive rights, protecting our environment and ensuring every child has the excellent education they deserve.
If this is the America you believe in, this campaign is for you.
**[We’re in for a tough election here in North Carolina, but with the help of committed supporters, we’ve won the toughest races before. I’m grateful to have Deb Haaland's support in this crucial race, and I’d like to have yours, too. Your donation today will help us take on the challenge of the most competitive Senate campaign in 2026. Please give whatever is right for you and split a donation between our team and Deb Haaland today.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250729_3_split?refcode=em20250729-3479&refcode2=3479_400544_sQF_UB&akid=3479%2E400544%2EsQF_UB)**

Roy Cooper

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Hill Country Community Foundation's 4 employees now manage $60M in flood donations -- and a somber duty," **Houston Chronicle's**Andrea Ball** -- "The [Guadalupe River floodwaters](https://substack.com/redirect/f5d8c318-cbf3-4151-82cb-ed5a5192ac66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were barely receding when a young man showed up in the lobby of the Community Foundation of the Texas Hill Country.

It was Sunday afternoon, two days after the [July 4 storm](https://substack.com/redirect/ed98745f-6bfd-4e8d-8072-958ad4d8e351?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) turned the river [into a predator](https://substack.com/redirect/819c41d7-92ab-466e-8069-9e48e25c9353?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that killed at least 137 people, swept away homes, tore down trees and ripped up roads. [The Community Foundation](https://substack.com/redirect/73655b8e-5e17-418d-88b9-5a2725ecf012?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a nonprofit serving 10 surrounding counties, was running at full speed, figuring out how and how fast they could help.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/47d8800e-60a0-4299-b393-0012d5648e94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The young man gave two $20 bills to **Jayne Zirkel** , the foundation's manager of marketing and events. He was the first person to walk into the Community Foundation with a donation. Zirkel gratefully took the money.

Over the next three weeks, hundreds more would follow.

The four-employee foundation has now raised more than $60 million to rebuild what the flood destroyed.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/47d8800e-60a0-4299-b393-0012d5648e94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Community Foundation of the Texas Hill Country was established in 1982 to foster a culture of philanthropy. It handles money from individual donors who don't want to create their own nonprofit and deal with the business-end of a charity, but want to support specific people or causes in the community.

The donors control how that money is spent, be it through individual scholarships or to specific nonprofits. Other people allow the foundation to disperse their money how it deems fit. The Community Foundation handles the mechanics.

The nonprofit serves 10 surrounding counties, including Uvalde, Blanco, Gillespie and Bandera. They may be rural counties, but its residents support charity. More than 250 donors currently use the foundation to support causes including music, animal welfare, housing, libraries and child welfare.

In 2024, the nonprofit gave $7.3 million to local charities. It does not give money to individuals.

The foundation posts details of how the fund is being spent on its website, including the recipients and size of the grants. It links where to [donate](https://substack.com/redirect/b6e5a8e4-e5bd-4c96-9a8e-7fb54b5827c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [volunteer.](https://substack.com/redirect/d812e6bb-4a33-4176-a0e6-3314940d6667?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Money continues to pour in from across the philanthropic spectrum: $2 million from HEB; $1 million from James Avery Artisan Jewelry, both Texas institutions that got their start in Kerrville; $25,000 from a woman who had saved up the money for a new car; thousands of dollars from lemonade stands across the country; millions from strangers across the world aching for Texas - with more coming in every day.

The flood fund is far more money than the nonprofit has ever handled at one time -- usually, a big year is $11 million**.**

So the 43-year-old foundation is busy building a sustainable plan for what will be a multi-year recovery, said**Austin Dickson** , CEO of the Community Foundation. They're talking to other foundations and potentially bringing in a third-party expert to help the nonprofit through the funding process.

"We're talking to the experts," Dickson said. "We're not sure exactly what this is going to look like yet."" [Hou Chron](https://substack.com/redirect/37156967-def3-48ec-8cdd-a0f1aab44422?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

TOP NEWS " Hill Country Community Foundation's 4 employees now manage $60M in flood donations -- and a somber duty," Houston Chronicle'sAndrea Ball -- "The were barely receding when a young man showed up in the lobby of the Community Foundation of the Texas Hill Country. It was Sunday afternoon, two days after the turned the river that killed at least 137 people, swept away homes, tore down trees and ripped up roads. , a nonprofit serving 10 surrounding counties, was running at full speed, figuring out how and how fast they could help. The young man gave two $20 bills to Jayne Zirkel , the foundation's manager of marketing and events. He was the first person to walk into the Community Foundation with a donation. Zirkel gratefully took the money. Over the next three weeks, hundreds more would follow. The four-employee foundation has now raised more than $60 million to rebuild what the flood destroyed. The Community Foundation of the Texas Hill Country was established in 1982 to foster a culture of philanthropy. It handles money from individual donors who don't want to create their own nonprofit and deal with the business-end of a charity, but want to support specific people or causes in the community. The donors control how that money is spent, be it through individual scholarships or to specific nonprofits. Other people allow the foundation to disperse their money how it deems fit. The Community Foundation handles the mechanics. The nonprofit serves 10 surrounding counties, including Uvalde, Blanco, Gillespie and Bandera. They may be rural counties, but its residents support charity. More than 250 donors currently use the foundation to support causes including music, animal welfare, housing, libraries and child welfare. In 2024, the nonprofit gave $7.3 million to local charities. It does not give money to individuals. The foundation posts details of how the fund is being spent on its website, including the recipients and size of the grants. It links where to and Money continues to pour in from across the philanthropic spectrum: $2 million from HEB; $1 million from James Avery Artisan Jewelry, both Texas institutions that got their start in Kerrville; $25,000 from a woman who had saved up the money for a new car; thousands of dollars from lemonade stands across the country; millions from strangers across the world aching for Texas - with more coming in every day. The flood fund is far more money than the nonprofit has ever handled at one time -- usually, a big year is $11 million. So the 43-year-old foundation is busy building a sustainable plan for what will be a multi-year recovery, saidAustin Dickson , CEO of the Community Foundation. They're talking to other foundations and potentially bringing in a third-party expert to help the nonprofit through the funding process. "We're talking to the experts," Dickson said. "We're not sure exactly what this is going to look like yet."" ($) FREE SUBSCRIPTIONS HAVE ENDED : As of July 11, 2022, we have moved to a paywall for free subscribers. I often give thanks, for whatever it's work, for some prescience in the course of unfolding current events. For example, the continuing consolidation of authoritarianism in America offers that opportunity on a seemingly daily basis: I spent a decade advocating for greater restraints on executive power, while Republicans and Democrats [repeatedly](https://substack.com/redirect/3208a9a5-e782-471d-a2ef-cf54474064bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) collaborated to undermine checks and balances in the years before Trump took office.
### **A new hope**
Soon after the longstanding Israeli genocide in Gaza accelerated in October 2023, I wrote [a post exploring the grassroots movement to challenge militarism](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the U.S. It examined the American labor movement, and reviewed the inspiring successes of three particular labor leaders who I hoped might take action supporting an indigenous people facing a genocide enabled in Washington & Tel Aviv.
## [We, the People, can unplug the war machine](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
| | [Shahid Buttar](https://substack.com/profile/15484941-shahid-buttar)| | *
---|---|---
| November 2, 2023
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[The world has watched in horror as a day of mass trauma for Isreal has escalated into an outright genocide of Palestinians living in Gaza. People around the world have taken to the streets by the millions in a global movement unrivaled by any since we tried to stop the American invasion of Iraq 20 years ago.](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
| [| Read full story
---](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
One of the labor leaders who I named as potentially crucial to ending the genocide was Chris Smalls, founder of the Amazon Labor Union. He was fired by Amazon in 2020 in retaliation for organizing protests over working conditions, and went on to successfully [organize his former worksite](https://substack.com/redirect/0bfe84cf-4730-4b9d-b699-c04a0e04c921?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) through a grassroots campaign focused on face-to-face outreach at locations including bus stops.
His leadership and contributions to the labor movement have been [internationally](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa6d8fd-5084-4b07-853c-b6d13a3ebb1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) recognized.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f76b6025-0bdc-49d6-8051-53aecec86e26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Smalls succeeded where any number of previous efforts by major unions had failed, and [pioneered a resurgent model of labor organizing](https://substack.com/redirect/5e66da6a-999f-4de1-9f39-36e587ffc4b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--focused on pounding pavement and building relationships across the rank & file--that had fallen out of favor in recent decades.
_Learning anything from this post? Pass it on!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=169624188&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY5NjI0MTg4LCJpYXQiOjE3NTQxNDM4OTYsImV4cCI6MTc1NjczNTg5NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.EeSg16bUHKtLzV7i2_10XYswd9qJS-GLc2TDPv_jLTg)
Smalls was a young, working class Amazon warehouse employee and became one of the most [renowned Black grassroots organizers](https://substack.com/redirect/af36b5c4-5333-402d-bf06-ceb9e6612f24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a generation. Meanwhile, his success using traditional organizing tools and strategies revealed that many seemingly more sophisticated techniques, such as those privileging institutional or digital outreach, were ultimately poor substitutes for more effective approaches they had displaced.
### Taking action rooted in solidarity
Smalls [recently joined the ](https://substack.com/redirect/1c4a284e-17ae-4379-94b0-f9405b7b2d5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Handala](https://substack.com/redirect/1c4a284e-17ae-4379-94b0-f9405b7b2d5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , a civilian ship organized by the Freedom Flotilla to deliver aid to Gaza despite the internationally illegal Israeli blockade. His participation in the mission--to deliver baby formula, food, and medical supplies--excited me, for two reasons.
First, [starving children in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/0316aae4-0852-49ed-a070-903fc0fcfbc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) need those supplies desperately. Israel's blockade of Gaza has denied even the most meager provisions to civilians including children, and represents [intentional mass starvation](https://substack.com/redirect/008e2252-0595-4c74-9a8c-604a9a3ee7da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Meanwhile, tens of thousands of Palestinians have been [murdered and assassinated](https://substack.com/redirect/70fa2c72-ebab-48ef-8889-a453ccb0b2e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by occupying Israeli forces complicit in the war crimes of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Any supplies that get through to Gaza could save the lives of whomever they reach.
Second, Smalls being on board suggested the possibility of the domestic labor movement engaging more broadly. To whatever extent [my November 2023 article](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was a work of fantasy, Smalls joining the flotilla seemed to suggest it was coming to life!
His work challenging Jeff Bezos made Smalls a [global labor hero](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa6d8fd-5084-4b07-853c-b6d13a3ebb1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Coming from someone with such well-deserved respect across the labor movement, his recognition of solidarity of Gaza--and [outspoken advocacy](https://substack.com/redirect/ec51f624-9bc3-4f7f-ba56-b952230b1eb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on behalf of human rights in Palestine--seemed like a gateway through which a broader constituency (both within and beyond the U.S.) might come to care about ending the genocide in Gaza.
Alongside the corruption of Congress, the courts, and the White House, militarism also relies on the participation of labor. Should an intersectionally resurgent labor movement assertively challenge genocide--by, for instance, maintaining strikes impeding any of a series of critical industries like transportation or shipping--Washington could be forced to capitulate to popular demands.
### **The plot thickens**
The _Handala_ left Gallipoli, an Italian port, about ten days ago. What the crew described as "[two alarming incidents](https://substack.com/redirect/514cb7aa-c3c3-4189-93c1-dd7e52e25a00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" on the day of its July 20 departure may have been acts of sabotage, but were ultimately addressed before the ship's [21-person team fielded from 10 different countries](https://substack.com/redirect/514cb7aa-c3c3-4189-93c1-dd7e52e25a00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) proceeded on their mission.
Despite being peaceful, that mission was fraught.
Just one month ago, Israel [assaulted a ship](https://substack.com/redirect/63235d49-4080-443f-9572-0b398a81eebb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) carrying a previous Freedom Flotilla mission, the _Madleen_. Israeli authorities abducted a dozen unarmed passengers, [including](https://substack.com/redirect/d29383e8-114a-41a7-bf54-5a234f622038?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) journalists and Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg. Those who declined to face tribunals were summarily deported.
As the _Handala_ approached Gaza this past Saturday, July 26, it was [intercepted](https://substack.com/redirect/dd1f9653-cfbc-42c6-8ee3-737103587732?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in international waters by Israeli authorities who abducted all of the ship's 21 passengers, including Chris Smalls.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ce91960-71c7-4626-9d6f-4324b0ef3376?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Before Smalls was ever allowed to meet with a lawyer, he was [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/1b576957-fb83-4093-91fe-67f76613afbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) assaulted in custody by seven Israelis wearing uniforms who "choked him and kicked him in the legs, leaving visible signs of violence on his neck and back."
When he was finally allowed to meet a lawyer, Smalls remained surrounded by half a dozen armed Israeli agents.
Smalls was reportedly the [only Black participant](https://substack.com/redirect/4a32bb16-50d7-490a-91cd-5bd9949f22c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the _Handala_ flotilla. And, as far as we know at the moment behind the shroud of Israeli secrecy, he is the only one who has been subjected to arbitrary--and seemingly retaliatory--state violence.
His experience encapsulates the racism with which zionism has long been effectively synonymous.

[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack..NHeSb97xrR_heFrbizDwioxfVE1LsBQS_Z6Z6Wh60RQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=169624188)
### **What happens next?**
The first question is how the State Department responds to the detention of the seven American citizens on board the _Handala_ , and the state violence targeting Chris Smalls. It's no secret that America has failed to assert pressure on Israel in other situations, including situations in which American citizens (like [Rachel Corrie](https://substack.com/redirect/021839ec-be20-40b7-aeee-674d867b81bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for instance) have suffered lethal violence by Israeli authorities.
Beyond the distressing situation on the ground, an exciting possibility offered by the _Handala_ appears to already be emerging: the galvanization of a consensus among domestic labor unions. For instance, the California Faculty Association, representing 29,000 educators in the California State University system, [issued a statement](https://substack.com/redirect/fbc63668-d2a4-42b7-8e11-1c5c7995e39e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in solidarity and corresponding call to action.
I tend to think of phone calls to the offices of elected representatives as generally meaningless, since their positions are usually based more on the whims of industries and industrialists than voters. This moment however, might offer a unique possibility because (in contrast to situations pitting grassroots concerns against industrial interests) there is no domestic political constituency clamoring to detain, beat, and potentially torture Chris Smalls.
[Find your Rep in Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/ad1ee206-03ab-4f2c-8bf7-7e83930c6723?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I urge you to call your elected leaders in Washington to demand that U.S. officials:
* defend the human rights of labor leader Chris Smalls and the other humanitarian activists aboard the _Handala_ ;
* ensure the overdue delivery of desperately needed aid to Gaza;
* cease military aid to Israel's internationally illegal genocide continuing in Gaza; and
* prevent similar complicity in human rights violations elsewhere.

If you or a family member are a member of a union, I also urge you to contact your union representatives and invite your union to take an active stance defending Chris Smalls, as well as the international human rights principles he has endured violence in order to defend in Gaza.
_Paid subscribers can access an update on[a previous post](https://substack.com/redirect/a8bc4a48-2c4f-4f8f-862d-1e5f8e72f86a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I wrote addressing a court ruling addressing the Trump administration's attack on birthright citizenship._
### Will the Supreme Court Overrule the Constitution Itself?
I [wrote earlier this month](https://substack.com/redirect/a8bc4a48-2c4f-4f8f-862d-1e5f8e72f86a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about a recent decision of the Supreme Court that limited the power of lower courts to issue nationwide injunctions. The decision addressed a xenophobic challenge to birthright citizenship, which is explicitly guaranteed by the 14th Amendment, and kept the case alive while returning it to lower courts.
Last Wednesday, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit issued [an important ruling](https://substack.com/redirect/1ceca60d-07e2-4961-96f9-47be94a3eb0d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) essentially reiterating the original injunction later limited by the Supreme Court. The three-judge panel concluded:
> "The district court correctly concluded that the executive order's proposed interpretation, denying citizenship to many persons born in the United States, is unconstitutional. We fully agree."
The underlying issue remains unresolved beyond the Ninth Circuit, but will likely return to the Supreme Court before it becomes settled for now. I have [few hopes in that forum](https://substack.com/redirect/41ef89ad-4c75-4d52-af63-7ac0293641b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (and even [fewer](https://substack.com/redirect/49e415db-d61e-4fde-a5e9-cdd264a66402?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the ultimate outcome considering the behavior of the executive branch under this administration) but remain dedicated nonetheless to chronicling these events as they continue to unfold.

### **A new hope**
Soon after the longstanding Israeli genocide in Gaza accelerated in October 2023, I wrote [a post exploring the grassroots movement to challenge militarism](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the U.S. It examined the American labor movement, and reviewed the inspiring successes of three particular labor leaders who I hoped might take action supporting an indigenous people facing a genocide enabled in Washington & Tel Aviv.

Smalls succeeded where any number of previous efforts by major unions had failed, and [pioneered a resurgent model of labor organizing](https://substack.com/redirect/5e66da6a-999f-4de1-9f39-36e587ffc4b5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--focused on pounding pavement and building relationships across the rank & file--that had fallen out of favor in recent decades.

Smalls was a young, working class Amazon warehouse employee and became one of the most [renowned Black grassroots organizers](https://substack.com/redirect/af36b5c4-5333-402d-bf06-ceb9e6612f24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in a generation. Meanwhile, his success using traditional organizing tools and strategies revealed that many seemingly more sophisticated techniques, such as those privileging institutional or digital outreach, were ultimately poor substitutes for more effective approaches they had displaced.
### Taking action rooted in solidarity
Smalls [recently joined the ](https://substack.com/redirect/1c4a284e-17ae-4379-94b0-f9405b7b2d5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[Handala](https://substack.com/redirect/1c4a284e-17ae-4379-94b0-f9405b7b2d5f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , a civilian ship organized by the Freedom Flotilla to deliver aid to Gaza despite the internationally illegal Israeli blockade. His participation in the mission--to deliver baby formula, food, and medical supplies--excited me, for two reasons.
First, [starving children in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/0316aae4-0852-49ed-a070-903fc0fcfbc5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) need those supplies desperately. Israel's blockade of Gaza has denied even the most meager provisions to civilians including children, and represents [intentional mass starvation](https://substack.com/redirect/008e2252-0595-4c74-9a8c-604a9a3ee7da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Meanwhile, tens of thousands of Palestinians have been [murdered and assassinated](https://substack.com/redirect/70fa2c72-ebab-48ef-8889-a453ccb0b2e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by occupying Israeli forces complicit in the war crimes of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
Any supplies that get through to Gaza could save the lives of whomever they reach.
Second, Smalls being on board suggested the possibility of the domestic labor movement engaging more broadly. To whatever extent [my November 2023 article](https://substack.com/redirect/ae228fda-d103-4c9a-8625-ab2396eb1e21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was a work of fantasy, Smalls joining the flotilla seemed to suggest it was coming to life!
His work challenging Jeff Bezos made Smalls a [global labor hero](https://substack.com/redirect/1aa6d8fd-5084-4b07-853c-b6d13a3ebb1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Coming from someone with such well-deserved respect across the labor movement, his recognition of solidarity of Gaza--and [outspoken advocacy](https://substack.com/redirect/ec51f624-9bc3-4f7f-ba56-b952230b1eb7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on behalf of human rights in Palestine--seemed like a gateway through which a broader constituency (both within and beyond the U.S.) might come to care about ending the genocide in Gaza.
Alongside the corruption of Congress, the courts, and the White House, militarism also relies on the participation of labor. Should an intersectionally resurgent labor movement assertively challenge genocide--by, for instance, maintaining strikes impeding any of a series of critical industries like transportation or shipping--Washington could be forced to capitulate to popular demands.
### **The plot thickens**
The _Handala_ left Gallipoli, an Italian port, about ten days ago. What the crew described as "[two alarming incidents](https://substack.com/redirect/514cb7aa-c3c3-4189-93c1-dd7e52e25a00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" on the day of its July 20 departure may have been acts of sabotage, but were ultimately addressed before the ship's [21-person team fielded from 10 different countries](https://substack.com/redirect/514cb7aa-c3c3-4189-93c1-dd7e52e25a00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) proceeded on their mission.
Despite being peaceful, that mission was fraught.
Just one month ago, Israel [assaulted a ship](https://substack.com/redirect/63235d49-4080-443f-9572-0b398a81eebb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) carrying a previous Freedom Flotilla mission, the _Madleen_. Israeli authorities abducted a dozen unarmed passengers, [including](https://substack.com/redirect/d29383e8-114a-41a7-bf54-5a234f622038?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) journalists and Swedish climate activist Greta Thunberg. Those who declined to face tribunals were summarily deported.
As the _Handala_ approached Gaza this past Saturday, July 26, it was [intercepted](https://substack.com/redirect/dd1f9653-cfbc-42c6-8ee3-737103587732?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in international waters by Israeli authorities who abducted all of the ship's 21 passengers, including Chris Smalls.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ce91960-71c7-4626-9d6f-4324b0ef3376?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Before Smalls was ever allowed to meet with a lawyer, he was [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/1b576957-fb83-4093-91fe-67f76613afbb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) assaulted in custody by seven Israelis wearing uniforms who "choked him and kicked him in the legs, leaving visible signs of violence on his neck and back."
When he was finally allowed to meet a lawyer, Smalls remained surrounded by half a dozen armed Israeli agents.
Smalls was reportedly the [only Black participant](https://substack.com/redirect/4a32bb16-50d7-490a-91cd-5bd9949f22c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the _Handala_ flotilla. And, as far as we know at the moment behind the shroud of Israeli secrecy, he is the only one who has been subjected to arbitrary--and seemingly retaliatory--state violence.
His experience encapsulates the racism with which zionism has long been effectively synonymous.

### **What happens next?**
The first question is how the State Department responds to the detention of the seven American citizens on board the _Handala_ , and the state violence targeting Chris Smalls. It's no secret that America has failed to assert pressure on Israel in other situations, including situations in which American citizens (like [Rachel Corrie](https://substack.com/redirect/021839ec-be20-40b7-aeee-674d867b81bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), for instance) have suffered lethal violence by Israeli authorities.
Beyond the distressing situation on the ground, an exciting possibility offered by the _Handala_ appears to already be emerging: the galvanization of a consensus among domestic labor unions. For instance, the California Faculty Association, representing 29,000 educators in the California State University system, [issued a statement](https://substack.com/redirect/fbc63668-d2a4-42b7-8e11-1c5c7995e39e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in solidarity and corresponding call to action.
I tend to think of phone calls to the offices of elected representatives as generally meaningless, since their positions are usually based more on the whims of industries and industrialists than voters. This moment however, might offer a unique possibility because (in contrast to situations pitting grassroots concerns against industrial interests) there is no domestic political constituency clamoring to detain, beat, and potentially torture Chris Smalls.
[Find your Rep in Washington](https://substack.com/redirect/ad1ee206-03ab-4f2c-8bf7-7e83930c6723?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I urge you to call your elected leaders in Washington to demand that U.S. officials:
* defend the human rights of labor leader Chris Smalls and the other humanitarian activists aboard the _Handala_ ;
* ensure the overdue delivery of desperately needed aid to Gaza;
* cease military aid to Israel's internationally illegal genocide continuing in Gaza; and
* prevent similar complicity in human rights violations elsewhere.

If you or a family member are a member of a union, I also urge you to contact your union representatives and invite your union to take an active stance defending Chris Smalls, as well as the international human rights principles he has endured violence in order to defend in Gaza.

body:

| | **“****A disproportionate number of illegal immigrants go to blue states, they amplify the effect of a blue state vote. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zem9maef9me7m6prksfopsgro80qbm58holdj818_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3hm9or1clh2bs)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z1hci1opmjo1hs8upqj1654nqbj8qt2gpug5khtg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3hm9or1clh2bs)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. They think you and I will be so relieved to see the border secure again and criminal illegal aliens deported, that you and I will be oblivious to this threat lying dormant under our very eyes.No way.My name is Rebecca Weber. I’m the chairwoman of AMAC Action. **AMAC Action is the most influential advocacy group in the country when it comes to standing for the values of conservative Seniors.****We’ve got 72 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates, who are the “feet on the street” advocates who contact Members of Congress and state legislators in their district offices.** **Moreover, our chapters and delegates help organize Town Hall meetings with elected officials and candidates to enable those locally of our 2,000,000 AMAC members to meet, hear, and question them.****And you should also know that we now have more than 337,000 AMAC members who respond to our “calls-to-action” and weigh in with members of the** **U.S. House and Senate, as well as their state legislators on the issues.** Quite simply, when we speak, Washington listens. [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zbn60eil46qb9fti8kf4jn6mck2mlfqb9b3kh798_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3hm9or1clh2bs)**[And AMAC Action needs your help today in this do-or-die battle to pass a Constitutional Amendment to protect your vote from being canceled out by an illegal alien or a convicted felon.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z6t6vfqq29mq5fubqn8e3q1115286pgo2s4jm2h0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3hm9or1clh2bs)** But I can’t do it without you. **No matter what issue you care about the most, if you and I don’t have a secure,_honest_ elections... none of it matters.**Inflation. Illegal immigration. Violent Crime. Drug use. Homelessness. The 2nd Amendment. Out of control spending. Social Security and Medicare insolvency. Right to Life. Indoctrination in our schools. Endless foreign wars. You name it. **[So please follow this link to sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zuojs5lq1vhlvff8br810bmg9b148b3m55e9p4mo_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3hm9or1clh2bs)** so that AMAC Action can put your representatives in Washington and in the state legislature on notice with a simple demand: Namely, that you will not tolerate this erosion of your vote.Now, here’s the bad news:Most state constitutions grant voting rights to “every” citizen, open-ended language that liberal activists argue permits localities to authorize non-citizen and even illegal alien voting. States should amend their constitutions to instead permit “only” citizens to vote. But there’s good news, too:Seven states have _expressly_ banned non-citizen voting already: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Louisiana, North Dakota, and Ohio.**What’s more, voters approve of constitutional amendments to ban non-citizen voting by overwhelming margins. Nearly 77% of Ohio voters approved a measure in 2022, while nearly 63% of Colorado voters approved one in 2020.** This is a solution whose time has come. You and I can do this. **[That’s why, when you’ve signed your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zen6jd48ui8hkd72a58gr18qf7t9998at2tvprhg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3hm9or1clh2bs), I'm also asking you to make a one-time contribution of $35 to give AMAC Action the resources to send out, collect, process, and tabulate millions of petitions.** The reality is, we don’t get a dime of taxpayer funding. Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America. This is important. _It means we can’t be bought._ On the other hand, the leftwing election fraud machine is funded by leftwing billionaires like Mark Zuckerberg and George Soros who are actively funneling _billions_ to dark money “non-profit” groups to “**reshape** ” our elections and our electorate.With that said, if you’re able to make a larger contribution – say $50, $75, $125, $250, $500, or even $1,000 – it would really be a life saver. Please hurry. In order to secure your vote in all future elections – and with 11.5 million illegals chomping to be included in the next census – **[your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution is vitally important.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zai95f4gpusaggo5l0g57nsncrl0p6t27ma66vug_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3hm9or1clh2bs)** Yes, this is about saving your vote from being canceled. It’s also about saving America.And it all starts with the straightforward premise that non-citizens and illegal aliens – no matter how many Kamala Harris and Joe Biden imported on their watch – should be banned from voting _and_ banned from being counted for apportioning congressional seats and electoral votes. Thank you in advance for joining the fight to secure your vote

subject: Socialism in America
body:
You have been selected to represent citizens in your state in Hillsdale College’s National Survey on Socialism.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z2t2gb6atdhtt4nc5q59qv4snvna5ks8jpmqrhh0_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jmcoj6c3h2bs)

| | Dear Friend of Liberty,

**You have been selected to represent citizens in your state in Hillsdale College's National Survey on Socialism. You can complete your survey at the link below: **

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/socialism-survey**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zvvi59pr74gbrtubdmn96vkvtfub20pa3c4eqms8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jmcoj6c3h2bs)

With your response, you will represent your state as part of a major sampling of opinion that can help us more clearly understand real Americans' views--views that will interest policymakers and opinion leaders.

A recent poll showed that over half of Generation Z is likely to vote for candidates with socialist positions. We have seen some of this in recent elections.

Recently, voters in America's largest city nominated a self-avowed socialist to be mayor. Some of his proposals include...
* Banning ICE agents from city limits

* Establishing city-owned grocery stores

* Instituting a $30-an-hour minimum wage

* Replacing the police with social workers

**In short, this candidate will bring _real, unapologetic socialism_ to America.**

**Why did this happen? **

For one thing, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried.

For another, too many are no longer being taught about America's great heritage of liberty and the importance of the Constitution to freedom.

This is because of the "progressive" Left's increasing success in hijacking American education at both the K-12 and college levels. **So, it 's no surprise that those who support socialist candidates tend to be college-educated!**

In the face of these efforts to indoctrinate the young and undermine informed patriotism, **Hillsdale 's educational outreach is needed now more than ever.**

By responding to **Hillsdale College 's National Survey on Socialism**, your honest opinions will help us understand the rise of socialism and form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country--Americans like you, who still revere our founding principles of liberty, as set forth in the Declaration of Independence, and which form the foundation of our Constitution.

If you agree, please represent your state and take **Hillsdale College 's National Survey on Socialism** today.

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/socialism-survey**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zaso6pq61t3dkrbj13bsmebq9r6k4h85ka6kd5eo_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jmcoj6c3h2bs)

In the face of socialism's recent success, we must remember: **it is never too late to preserve and defend liberty through education.**

You can easily make your gift after completing the **National Survey on Socialism**, which you can access at this secure link:

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/socialism-survey**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2za4cavnsmclnvk9ip6c3mseitd29phrb3qg179to_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jmcoj6c3h2bs)

body:
I know her better than the liberal media, her Democrat opponent, and the DC establishment making the attack ads about her.

[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsb70co7ae9122b1hh3a2a5am677ks4lgg8f1gfo_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jm6o72c1h2bs)[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ze1pac1tpo0d81pn3p48hp4jt5l5bn9fethp60dg_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jm6o72c1h2bs)Friend,
I'm Terence Sears, and I know my wife, Winsome, better than anyone else. I know her better than the liberal media, her Democrat opponent, and the DC establishment making the attack ads about her.
Winsome and I met serving in the Marines, and after she served for four years as an electrician, she left the military and we got married.[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc63mh70uoi33ni901fcbghgrubb76k2mbksps3o_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jm6o72c1h2bs)Sometimes, people ask her why she served her country even though she was an immigrant.
Her answer shows exactly who she is at her core: Because her dad was able to create a life in America after coming here with only $1.75 in his pocket, and she wanted to give back to the nation that gave her so much.
Winsome has spent her life giving back to her communities. She has a deep faith and trust in our Lord and follows His teachings to treat all her neighbors with kindness because she knows they were created in the image of God.
She has led a men's prison Bible study and served as the director of a women's homeless shelter, and that's the work she's most proud of in her life.
Her greatest achievement--aside from building our beautiful family--has been serving as the first Black female to hold statewide office as Virginia's Lieutenant Governor.[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrna23itlpaia1ec7n4akqdsnumtic2jgtmfu2do_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jm6o72c1h2bs)Virginia was once the capital of the Confederacy, and now, Virginia's second-in-command is a strong Black woman.
I'm so proud of my wife, but let me tell you - her work is nowhere near done.
Winsome Earle-Sears is running for Governor to keep spreading her positive conservative message and to show the nation that a Black female immigrant - or someone of any color or background - can accomplish anything they set their mind to in America.
So far, Winsome has seen such an amazing outpouring of support, but her opponent has George Soros' bottomless pockets on her side, so she's been massively outraised.[That's why I'm respectfully asking you to support the incredible, sincere, and inspiring woman that I married, Winsome Earle-Sears, with a donation of even just a few bucks.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0o77ig9lho14skhmjr27qc4mohh892cc34ab1t8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jm6o72c1h2bs)[CHIP IN TO WINSOME >>
](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zap03j16sh7iv83gnac061ssiq38a0ijhae4ncc8_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jm6o72c1h2bs)She knows that this is going to be a long, tough fight, but there's no one better equipped for the job. She pours her heart and soul into everything she does, and serving as the first Black female governor in America will be no different.
Winsome will continue to see Jesus in everyone she meets, whether they're her political opponents, no matter their background, whether they're at rock bottom, or if they're thriving.[CHIP IN TO WINSOME FOR GOVERNOR >>
](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z816egtb11g0rv05h9ftbdhcvgf73m9migtihmng_rp22sh2s8i6epb6c3jm6o72c1h2bs)We're both so happy you're on our side. If you can't afford to chip in even a dollar today, just keep us in your prayers.
Thank you, Terence Sears

## U.S. Rail Giants Plan Historic $85B Merger
Union Pacific announced it will acquire Norfolk Southern in an $85 billion cash-and-stock deal announced Tuesday, creating the [first transcontinental freight railroad operator](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAURL8Gd0QYY4MLite4y2u3tDBcJ3eDwYKbRP77lSPtF2w30oyORufrOl8dRky3_24DS2ueE7xrBCIoMxWXqs-JMEEiF4vDWLILNEshey4078QcHMZjVk2wK4CErgHb6r4zwzga1dytcWvbS2_kIrz2ajBG6bYPXuig27bvGrQnTehOtEIMsruoZQit7L0ZtVqDG5gSEJByuXxnTHSHNR75BeXi89ZEeyfaK-v-MTkxOaVjz5XOisnpBDM5CX3mkclpeVZMUCuT0zNhTnx3Hlf0vFLBB1QewEVOmS_Pgxd8uchTLmuOD46Jm37hG9wc_xXxmTM5NcWG_Y0xYh00U-K2OYyfe_Qnpy8rfwIAAP__VGiKkw) in U.S. history The combined company [would control over 50,000 route miles](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHPmzAQxvFPA5uRMQYng4cubOnaER32Ga41dmQfofn2VSp16frujx799fvxWB5AkdL2HQ60HPKS8KoRmbEsXCBVlxNTwsQQC1AsGTwvSqpRSCMGuXig-F50621AVDi0aHszDrfpfr_pdrfaeIcBtHF61XoFN8A6BjN6A-j7dWrJft6kGWQv5aSGTq-T79Xobnejg4ep0RI9cS7dz0yJdwzxnV9YOpePNtqd-Vmb4Vuj5kbN13V1If9ez0oJa_1sGjVHClj5HbFR85koJ_EER4GcSLmEHH-Jmk_esSRxYNlQuILAlDYRqFQWZxX_Y4h_Gm2x_nlRjFQn02i5HUDxbxt_CfRl1Z8AAAD___HRkJU) and claim a market value above $250 billion. Executives say the merger will reduce shipping delays, expand routes, and boost U.S. competitiveness. Regulatory approval could take up to two years. If cleared, the deal would reshape the national freight system and intensify competition with Canadian carriers and Warren Buffett’s BNSF Railway, formerly the Burlington Northern and Santa Fe Railway.
## EPA to Repeal Obama-Era Climate Ruling
The Environmental Protection Agency announced Tuesday it will move to [repeal its Obama-era determination that greenhouse gas emissions](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQRb8Gd0QEMOCCYht32XZLi8DYYR8GazxJlL9_4v3C60Ya3aN77r_bcgu55Lr9DTt4WttS4X0WIAJcCEM9Y6uUK1QKBUMu2EKiRQo5cmG5EksKuXwWPSS_AkhQA_irHZUz0-T08PBOOxdXZ4KJNiqwapWTuBsZ3TTCpMch-04TVomrEEaqi76bdJVjdJPVawqGaQEpU8PL_5YrPWAtn_YCvMS2D8U_iI6TqT9MzkzO9XO0k_qLybmDmZyF7ffE5Pw8efdjciZ87gfHVro8v4f4xQlzKblVnlopAU_eVp5g5xsCVB4DcoTtWQLlVjtiQJ-Od8-cxjIttj3k8lOKfrXky8vvAAAA__-HOoff) endanger human health, a move that would also eliminate vehicle emissions standards tied to that finding. EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin said the action, expected to be finalized soon, would ease regulatory burdens and lower consumer costs. The 2009 finding served as the legal basis for a wide range of climate rules over the past 15 years. The agency argues that new developments cast doubt on the original scientific record and plans to make the [formal announcement soon](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuS5CAMhk-DM3dhgV8BwSZks-mGLrWRp7WFwQWacfXtt9grjKIvkPQ__nxsH8iR0-dvPMnJkbdEd40kQmWTgqnuOQknSoKxIMeSMcgGGsZez73RW0CO7812wR1EQKYjN8yjWaZ1XWz3cjAdiLQvz3XG8UmD0StMBuwQ9sHQgR279k3PRg9aT2Ae9jmFAcZ9WWd7BJyU1RRYcnn8zZzkRUd8528qjz2fXXQvkasq80uBV-Dv-358VZQc8N0WFPgqubwV-JZMgb9yZOG9YRNW4PXceFXg6cK-0EUY-z3yiUK9IMeLL-rp5Fo5p9qXr0gK_DJasLpNu--KC9fNMXKdZmX154kc_1uUH_X67eBfAAAA__8cUor_).
## NYC Gunman Targeted NFL Offices
The gunman who killed four people and seriously wounded another in Manhattan on Monday was targeting the [NFL’s corporate offices](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGupCAUxvGnwQ6DCCIFxTZ2s-2W5IwclQ3CLJwd49vfzH2FW_-SL1_-fx7-ATHFvP-GEx1txWe8WkIirJ4q5LaWTDFjJkgVYqoFAnkppObC8FH4ADHdXnXBbYgSxw7dYPQ4T9bOqjucFkZbK9QKg7VqxhlRCjtMWj2fowmhi-6zJswoBiEmOfbqOYVB6nW2Rm0BJqYEhkil9n9LzHTglu7yxtqv5eySO4hejY2_mFyYXK7r6rG98geZXPKWmFwalXozuXgmlxiYXJSe9TAp87GjFMLKL2icoO5IMe88b4kfCOHff6iEtfF8r_yEu1Te4G5ddeF1xZRimwxTYj8hpu8_9KOIbye_AgAA___Q7oY5) and carried a suicide note that blamed football injuries for his mental illness. Shane Tamura, 27, entered the office building Monday evening and shot four people in the lobby, killing three, including a police officer. He then [mistakenly took an elevator](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-SpyAMx58GOx0MCFJQXGO3117pZAF_5gZhB3M_x7e_cV9hq6TIJ98_fz7WD6RM5fUbj-R5q2tJ15kTc2orNyxnqIWppMKYG1JuFSOvIGHqpe2VXCNSvlfdRb-lBEl1yY92UrNxbtbd7meFyY46BDc6o0BaZZU2JgZrnLPpsyP_fJNWyVFKA2rQnyaOMIXZWb1FNELLFIlrG_5WKrynLd_1ndoQ6tFlvzN_nUL9ErAIWK7rGv6dyDXi_RwIWE6u7RawPMmegUy1CFgeWQGLtM_uBCwHlh2ZsfTlDv2518pUXv2bAtPxoPOkx3lyIL-Zrvn4dVHOdBortHwdSPnbFP-oybeH_wEAAP__R7-E1g) past the NFL offices to the 33rd floor, where he killed one more person before taking his own life. Tamura claimed to suffer from chronic traumatic encephalopathy–[commonly known as CTE](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD1yhDAMRk9jOhj_YUzhIg3dpk3JCNssToy9Y7TLcPuMN0dIJRVPT9L3dZtvEGJI90_YvcE1z8mfR_SIvsxYIB02JwzJJ4RYIMSSweHMKe9bOrSCzg5CvGbZOLN6z71ovGFDL7QaRy2bzQinWC9HxoXlWlolFr1YPWjHFqWsXptgqo0OgjJKFRedXJRjvLd6HOTqQBFJvQuYS_edQ8LNr_HKL186m_cmmg3xcRDxQfhE-HSeZ_c8ALODqwKETwfmchE-1c9qAQw5ET7VtYRPdKj9-Ae0Vy4_rQ14tTukDRAhtceWM4Z0b58PB-irRPeSackEfU83xbjHGWIMhxqIpPcdQnyfh__K9GX4bwAAAP__FEWI8Q)–in his suicide note, which he tied back to playing high school football. _“Study my brain, please,”_ the [final page](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MHOnCAUBeCnwR0GAUEXLJo07qabpunSoFz0NggTuJ3JvH1jX-Fff8nJOef3Y314TJiPH_4CR7GsGd4tARHUlarPbS-ZMEMmn6rHVIsPtEohRy4sV2INHtNn1V1wEUCC6sANdlSTmedJd6fTegijBBv8bOykxaiimfy0T2GLym6-Q3enCavEIISRqtebCYMc92m2OgZvmBYQkErt_xTMdEJMn_KC2u_l6pI7iZ6NqW9MLkwuftvvBf1RbmZy-fWTyeXCQOWdeTtLIcwHb3_bE3biCSLxXAj4BZmw5BtzTHwnYHJpVOqHqQUDU98HqQejZmO66sLzjSlhM5ZpcVwe0_829KULX07-CwAA___3LYX5) of the note said, _“I’m sorry.”_

## Shipley Do-Nuts Sold, Plans 40 New Stores
Houston-based Shipley Do-Nuts has been acquired from Austin-based Peak Rock Capital, which has owned the chain since 2021, [by a California private equity firm](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LESnCAQBuCnwQ4HFkUsKNLYXdqUDsJyMkExgnq-fcabvEHqndn___5fr_FlQgzr-6dZUJePT-OKV45YCu5jnsMW8c4puglxDifuuKQT3QgMWso6KtjoTIj32FROT8z1vELNu1aoToCU1aydEJ41vTVth4obB8JiI4B5Cy1IY6ugn2esE4xzxpmolUfBlPHeOW5kL0nD0IWS9rrMWPBjso93OnGvbVqqqOdStkzEDwIDgeG6rvr3nI7nSGAwewk2IoHhcREYYrImEhj-2ahLdD1Kpg-Sbns4TUGKf45QbjqnI5e00m8ogQFUS6HtOZdGUqV4T5tJAFXWKApMtP00NZ4jr3bttivEGLLsSMPeiwnx27b838anhr8BAAD__69Nj6A). Donate to power our work.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112386682/560358343/-246980373?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis_email_202050730-NDRC-Tier1-LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=202050730-NDRC-Tier1-LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis_&utm_campaign=LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMzNmVhYWI1LTNjNmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ba-qZNpV_8MhprobJxAQhvm8QmNv77Q8LAKhZr7KH30=)
Ron DeSantis has boasted a shameful record of suppressing the will of the people, championing and signing multiple laws that restrict voting rights and attack democracy.
Breaking down his anti-voter tenure is a bit of a doozy, so bear with us:
**DeSantis Undermines Amendment 4**
**In 2018,** Floridians voted to pass Amendment 4 to restore voting rights to roughly 1 million former felons in Florida. **But in 2019** , DeSantis and his extremist allies undercut the amendment through S.B. 7066, which required a full payment of all fines and fees before voting rights were restored. With no way of tracking debts and many unable to afford the fines, an estimated 774,000 Floridians were blocked from registering.
**DeSantis Targets Vote-by-Mail and Voter Assistance**
**In 2021,** DeSantis signed S.B. 90 into law, restricting several voting access points. It barred non-poll workers from handing out food and water to folks waiting in line, shortened the window for absentee ballot requests, and imposed restrictions on the ballot drop box period. A judge ruled that this did violate the Voting Rights Act (VRA), but far-right Floridian officials challenged the decision. The case is under review in a federal appeals court.
**DeSantis Weaponizes Voter Fraud Hysteria**
**In 2022,** DeSantis signed S.B. 524 into law, which banned ranked choice voting and imposed stricter ID requirements for mail-in ballots. At his urging, the law also created an election police force to investigate supposed fraud. Shortly after its enactment, 20 people were arrested for allegedly casting illegal ballots. But it was soon discovered that many of these individuals genuinely thought they were eligible and even received voter registration cards from DeSantis’ administration. It was a clear move to attempt to scare voters.
That same year, DeSantis gutted a Black opportunity district by pushing a discriminatory congressional map that deliberately split Black voters in North Florida — dividing them across districts and disenfranchising them intentionally. Our fair maps movement built public opposition to the map, and despite a ruling that said the map violated the Florida Constitution, the map was able to be used in the 2022 election and was still upheld by the Florida Appeals Court.
**A DeSantis Power Grab**
**In 2023,** after local prosecutors and judges rejected many of DeSantis’ election crime cases, he pushed through S.B. 4B, which gave his anti-voter extremist buddy, the Republican Attorney General, control over these cases. It was a blatant power grab to bypass any checks and balances to advance his efforts to suppress voters.
**DeSantis Targets Petition Drives in Attack on Direct Democracy**
**Just two months ago, in May,** DeSantis signed H.B. 1205 into law, which creates unnecessary restrictions on who can circulate petitions, adds cumbersome ID requirements, and subjects groups to extreme penalties for simple administrative mistakes that could even result in prison time.
**We know this was a lot to take in Hey Peter, but unfortunately for them, radicals like DeSantis deserve all of the heat we’re bringing. **
[**By making a donation to the NDRC, you’re powering our fight against extremists like Ron DeSantis. Our Map of Shame is just getting started, and with your support, we’ll expose attacks on free and fair elections and hold anti-democracy politicians accountable in every area across the country.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112386683/560358344/-246980373?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis_email_202050730-NDRC-Tier1-LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=202050730-NDRC-Tier1-LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis_&utm_campaign=LiftNoteMapShameDeSantis&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImMzNmVhYWI1LTNjNmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Ba-qZNpV_8MhprobJxAQhvm8QmNv77Q8LAKhZr7KH30=)

There’s no better place to start than the map of Florida’s Governor Ron DeSantis — you can read more below. = \----------Forwarded Message---------- Date: Monday, July 14, 2025 From: Team NDRC Subject: Shame, shame, shame Republicans have continuously given themselves artificial power so they can advance right-wing priorities that are out of touch with the majority of Americans. As relentless defenders of democracy, we work to hold those bad actors accountable, at the ballot box and in the public eye, so we are excited to launch The NDRC Map of Shame. We’re calling out the worst offenders — the most galling efforts to manipulate our democracy, cling to unearned power, and undermine the will of the people. This initiative will expose how anti-voter extremists are actively working to dismantle fair representation as a part of a coordinated effort by Republicans across the country — on both the state and federal levels. Our first ever NDRC Map of Shame offender is... 🥁Florida’s Congressional Map championed by Governor Ron DeSantis of Florida! | = = Ron DeSantis has boasted a shameful record of suppressing the will of the people, championing and signing multiple laws that restrict voting rights and attack democracy. Breaking down his anti-voter tenure is a bit of a doozy, so bear with us: DeSantis Undermines Amendment 4 In 2018, Floridians voted to pass Amendment 4 to restore voting rights to roughly 1 million former felons in Florida. But in 2019 , DeSantis and his extremist allies undercut the amendment through S.B. 7066, which required a full payment of all fines and fees before voting rights were restored. With no way of tracking debts and many unable to afford the fines, an estimated 774,000 Floridians were blocked from registering. DeSantis Targets Vote-by-Mail and Voter Assistance In 2021, DeSantis signed S.B. 90 into law, restricting several voting access points. It barred non-poll workers from handing out food and water to folks waiting in line, shortened the window for absentee ballot requests, and imposed restrictions on the ballot drop box period. A judge ruled that this did violate the Voting Rights Act (VRA), but far-right Floridian officials challenged the decision. The case is under review in a federal appeals court. DeSantis Weaponizes Voter Fraud Hysteria In 2022, DeSantis signed S.B. 524 into law, which banned ranked choice voting and imposed stricter ID requirements for mail-in ballots. At his urging, the law also created an election police force to investigate supposed fraud. Shortly after its enactment, 20 people were arrested for allegedly casting illegal ballots. But it was soon discovered that many of these individuals genuinely thought they were eligible and even received voter registration cards from DeSantis’ administration. It was a clear move to attempt to scare voters. That same year, DeSantis gutted a Black opportunity district by pushing a discriminatory congressional map that deliberately split Black voters in North Florida — dividing them across districts and disenfranchising them intentionally. Our fair maps movement built public opposition to the map, and despite a ruling that said the map violated the Florida Constitution, the map was able to be used in the 2022 election and was still upheld by the Florida Appeals Court. A DeSantis Power Grab In 2023, after local prosecutors and judges rejected many of DeSantis’ election crime cases, he pushed through S.B. 4B, which gave his anti-voter extremist buddy, the Republican Attorney General, control over these cases. It was a blatant power grab to bypass any checks and balances to advance his efforts to suppress voters. # [The American tradition of punching up](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=169463123&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY5NDYzMTIzLCJpYXQiOjE3NTM4NzgzODgsImV4cCI6MTc1NjQ3MDM4OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.zkGWo0h5a89q9ouHdBz45t_JeiN_kvdhjr0vGVfrIwg)
### Between last week's South Park, the death of Tom Lehrer, and the cancellation of Colbert, satire is back in the news.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
| Jul 30
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=169463123&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTY5NDYzMTIzLCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc1Mzg3ODM4OCwiZXhwIjoxNzU2NDcwMzg4LCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMjQ0MDM5OCIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.EWiqfKbHEOV1zobGP5QovQWrp8TExgiCn2FNu8q62Xg&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)
