We all know that mail-in voting laws are about ballot accessibility, making it easier for voters to participate in our elections . Elderly voters, the disabled, our military service members -- they all vote by mail.
Mail-in voting has happened dating back to the Civil War. It's always been safe and secure, mail-in voting fraud is supremely rare. States have spent millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing. It's been used widely in some states for decades and in most of the country since the pandemic.
Our partners at VoteAmerica said it best: “ There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access, reject ballots without postmarks, or refuse to count ballots that arrive after Election Day. If the administration moves forward with these proposals, they will effectively disenfranchise older voters, rural voters, and military voters. ”
Opponents of voting rights have proven they'll go to any length necessary to stop people from voting and make sure that they stay in power. body:
#

Growing up, this little boy learned that through hard work, he could do anything he set his mind to.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-july25.pQQVdM&refcode=em250730-1-700k&t=1&akid=6137%2E6688874%2Ej_PcM0)
At the age of 23, he became a United States naval aviator. He deployed twice on the U.S.S. Midway and flew 39 combat missions in Operation Desert Storm.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-july25.pQQVdM&refcode=em250730-1-700k&t=2&akid=6137%2E6688874%2Ej_PcM0)
Then, at the age of 32, he was selected as an astronaut (with his twin brother, Scott!). He flew his first of four missions into space in 2001 aboard Space Shuttle Endeavour. He spent more than 50 days in space and has lived on the International Space Station.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-july25.pQQVdM&refcode=em250730-1-700k&t=3&akid=6137%2E6688874%2Ej_PcM0)
In 2011, Mark's wife, Former Congresswoman Gabby Giffords, was shot in Tucson during an event where she was meeting with her constituents. Mark retired from the Navy and NASA, and his mission turned from service to his country to caring for his wife. But Gabby's service in Congress, using policy to improve people's lives, stuck with him.
So, in 2020, Mark took on his next mission — running for U.S. Senate in Arizona — and won.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-july25.pQQVdM&refcode=em250730-1-700k&t=4&akid=6137%2E6688874%2Ej_PcM0)
Then, in 2022, he had to turn around and run for a full term in the Senate. And thanks to our incredible team, he won again.
[](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-july25.pQQVdM&refcode=em250730-1-700k&t=5&akid=6137%2E6688874%2Ej_PcM0)
Now, Mark’s in yet another important position. As Vice Chair of the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee, it’s on Mark to find a way to defend every incumbent Democrat in the Senate. And, to win back our majority, he’s got to take four seats back from the GOP, too.
It’s a tall task. But if anybody can do it, it’s Mark — and he needs your help.

With great humility and endless hope for the future of America, I have an announcement to make: **I am running for U.S. Senate.**
**I’m Roy Cooper.** I had the honor of serving North Carolina as Attorney General and Governor.
[**Now, I am asking for your support to serve our nation as the next Democratic United States Senator from North Carolina. I’m grateful that Chris Pappas is already on our team, and if you’re ready to join us, please split a donation between our team and theirs right now >>>**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250730_1_cooper?refcode=em20250730-1678&amount=5&refcode2=1678_582294_sBpgKG&akid=1678%2E582294%2EsBpgKG)
Democrats’ best hope of stopping the chaos in Washington is to retake the Senate in 2026, and our race here in NC is set to be the most competitive election next year. We can’t take back the Senate without flipping this seat from red to blue — and The Hill has rated our race the most likely Senate seat to flip.
Here’s something you may not know about me: **I’ve already won some of the most competitive elections here in battleground North Carolina.** I won my elections for Governor in 2016 and 2020 — the same years that Donald Trump carried the state.
NC is one of the last, true purple states, but we’ve proven together that Democrats _can_ win. We know what we have to do.
As Senator, I will fight for our rights to the ballot box, reproductive health care, cleaner air and water, and more. I will work to make health care _more_ affordable and accessible — not yank it away from those most in need. I’ll advocate for better public schools, more clean energy options, and opportunities for good-paying jobs. I will defend our democracy.
**I will not back down. I refuse to let Republicans in Washington take this country backward.**

Donald Trump and the MAGA GOP are pushing for reckless war in the Middle East, economy-crippling tariffs, and deep cuts to Medicaid, nutritional assistance, and more.

All that — and yet, based on a new poll, _voters find the GOP more favorable than Dems._
**Right now, the Democratic Party is 30 points under water with registered voters.**

subject: We’re building careers, not just job listings
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
Governor Andy Beshear is thinking beyond the next headline, Peter.

He’s thinking about what life will look like for Kentucky families 10, 20, even 30 years from now.

And the truth is that future starts with a job — _not just a job for today_ — a long-term career that helps someone build a life, raise a family, and retire comfortably and with dignity.

That doesn’t just mean helping businesses create jobs and bring them to the Bluegrass State. It’s also about making sure Kentuckians are ready to step into those jobs once they’re created. That means giving every person the tools to pursue a trade, skill, or higher education — and making sure no high school graduate is left without a plan for what comes next.

Andy is focused on building pathways to make this happen. He’s working to expand access to pre-K, so kids get ahead and parents can reenter the workforce, investing in programs that connect students with real opportunities before they even graduate, and working to stay ahead of industry trends so Kentucky’s economy keeps getting stronger into the future.

Peter, true leaders don’t focus on quick fixes, **they work toward solutions that last long after their term is over, where families and communities continue to feel the benefits for years to come.** That’s the kind of leadership we aim to support at In This Together PAC. But in order to do it, we need your support to help fund the next generation of leaders.

body:
For the last time in a while, I’m coming to you directly to ask:
#
Peter,
**In case you missed it, I’m soon returning to active duty in the Marine Corps.**
I’ll be serving through August 2026 and I won’t be able to engage in any political activity during that time. **The Heartland team will keep carrying out our mission, but I wanted to let you know that this will be the last time you'll hear directly from me for a while.**
Before I say anything else, I want to say thank you — for believing in our mission, for standing up for working families, and for helping us build something real and lasting. I’ve always been grateful for your support and I’m so proud of this new grassroots movement we’re building together.
**The reality is that Heartland Patriots is really just getting started.** Later this year and into next, our team will start making investments into candidates who will boldly stand up to the billionaires, corporate elites, and political insiders dominating our politics. But right now, we’re still building our war chest — and we’re counting on your help to do it.

Peter—In a moment, I’m going to ask you to [**chip in just $5 before our critical end-of-month fundraising deadline,**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112436606/560479479/-2027950711?refcode=em25_250730_eom3_fndd_gq_act___KS_ettx&utm_campaign=em25_250730_eom3_fndd_gq_act___KS_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=5e1c95bd-746d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZTFjOTViZC03NDZkLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IRY56yJSQm35BrNb9POFGRjLAs5pjPrwMKMxorWZUwc=) but first I want to let you know why I’m counting on your support.

From the moment he became House Speaker, _Mike Johnson has shown us exactly what kind of "leader" he is._

**He's shown no independence, and followed Trump’s far-right marching orders to the letter, using shady-tactics and disregarding the very voters who are directly impacted by his policies. It's clear that his loyalties lie with the president— _and not with the American people._**

He's proudly supported Trump's Big, Ugly Bill to give more handouts to the wealthy by slashing funding for Medicaid, Medicare, and SNAP. **Coming from a working-class family myself, I know the struggles firsthand, and I'm not about to let anyone come between me and delivering a better future for my fellow Pennsylvanians. **

Donald Trump’s “Big, Ugly Bill” is a direct assault on reproductive freedom, Peter. It guts Medicaid, defunds Planned Parenthood health centers, and denies millions of people essential reproductive care. name: Dr. Maxine Dexter
subject: Sixty years later, Medicaid is under siege.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Maxine for Congress
body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Peter,
Medicaid turns 60 today.
As a physician, I see Medicaid save lives every day. It gives millions of people a chance for medical care when there’s nowhere else to turn. It supports families through their hardest moments, giving them breathing room when they need it most.
Medicaid isn’t perfect, but it stands for dignity and a fight toward fairness. Every day, health care workers do everything they can to make that promise real—helping people get the care they deserve and have a chance at a better life.
But now, under Donald Trump’s Big, Ugly Betrayal, Medicaid funding has been slashed.
Here’s what that means for the rest of us:
❌ Nearly 200,000 Oregonians, and 17 million Americans, are at risk of losing their health care.
❌ Trump is giving ICE access to the personal data of 79 million Americans on Medicaid—violating patient privacy to target our immigrant communities.
❌ Republicans piled on even more red tape and work requirements for eligibility that could result in more than 500 preventable deaths in Oregon every year.
Our health care shouldn’t be looted and held hostage by the wealthy and powerful. Health care should be a right that belongs to every single one of us, no matter who we are. And as long as I’m standing, I’ll keep fighting to protect and expand the care we deserve.
Here’s what we’re doing to fight back:
✔️ Oregon and 19 other states are suing the Trump administration for violating patient privacy rights.
✔️ I’ve co-sponsored legislation to create universal, state-based health care, protect abortion access, expand Medicaid and CHIP, and ensure veterans receive the care they’ve earned.
✔️ I helped launch the Congressional Doctors Caucus—six Democratic physicians creating science-based policy, fighting disinformation from quacks like RFK Jr., and standing up to the 11 GOP physicians who voted to gut Medicaid.
This is our first major campaign deadline since Trump’s six-month mark and Republicans’ vote on the Big, Ugly Betrayal. Let’s make this a referendum on their cruelty—chip in today and power our fight to defend health care as a human right. Hi folks,
It’s Ben, Michael Bennet’s Campaign Manager.
As a country, we are navigating some incredibly tumultuous times right now. Unfortunately, our President and leadership in Washington are only contributing to the dysfunction rather than delivering real solutions.
Michael is running for Governor because he knows that in this political moment, Coloradans can set their own course. From building more affordable housing, fighting to lower the cost of healthcare and childcare, modernizing our public schools, and protecting our public lands—these solutions will be forged right here at home by all of us, working together.
Michael is ready to continue leading our state with vision and determination while providing the rest of the country with the hopeful path forward we desperately need.
As our campaign manager, I am responsible for ensuring that our campaign has the resources, infrastructure, and momentum to make this possible.
While we’re grateful for the widespread support we’ve received, we can’t take our foot off the gas now. We’ve got well-funded Republican opponents running in this race and a long campaign ahead of us. We have to be prepared for everything that will be thrown our way.
To win this race, we’re going to need your support, friend. Our campaign hits its July fundraising goal tomorrow at midnight. Can you chip in whatever you can to keep us moving forward? Every dollar counts >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q3?refcode=X_250730_benwaldon_eom1_act]

body:
I have thought on it and prayed about it, and I have decided. I’m in.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250730-1?refcode=em-20250730-1&refcode2=387_1086043_CQlLDl&akid=387%2E1086043%2ECQlLDl)
**[I’m Roy Cooper. I’m a proud Democrat. I’m also a former Governor and Attorney General from North Carolina. Today, I’m asking for your support to be the next United States Senator and help Democrats take BACK the Senate Majority in 2026. If you’re ready to join me in the fight, split a contribution between Wes Moore and my campaign today >>>](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250730-1?refcode=em-20250730-1&refcode2=387_1086043_CQlLDl&akid=387%2E1086043%2ECQlLDl)**
**North Carolinians already know this about me, Peter:** I’ve spent my life in service to our state, and my record shows that I will do everything in my power to deliver results for our people.
That’s why North Carolinians elected me Governor in some of the most competitive races in the nation — _twice._
Now, this election is set to be the most competitive Senate race of 2026, and the national GOP will go to any lengths to defeat us. Everyone knows that the path to retaking the Senate Majority and STOPPING Washington Republicans starts here in NC.
**[If we’re going to win, we need Democrats from across this country to join our fight. I hope to see your name on the list of Founding Donors starting our campaign off strong, and just $10 will go a long way. Can I count on you to split a contribution of any size right away?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250730-1?refcode=em-20250730-1&refcode2=387_1086043_CQlLDl&akid=387%2E1086043%2ECQlLDl)**
Peter, I have a long record of getting things done — from taking on big banks as Attorney General to getting Medicaid expansion passed when I was Governor.
I’m not afraid of doing hard work to make our country better. _And I’m not afraid to speak out when politicians are doing something wrong, either._
Too many Republicans in Washington have lost all sense of duty to our people and our country. They see only the prospect of getting on Donald Trump’s wrong side and losing their power. **This cannot continue.**
Americans deserve leaders who will serve the people, not their own partisan agenda.
_Meanwhile, Donald Trump has handpicked a loyalist candidate to run against me._
As Senator, I will defend our democracy. I’ll stand up for voting rights, work hard to restore abortion access, advocate for policies that will protect our air and drinking water, and do everything possible to bring jobs and opportunity to our economy.
**[My promise to you is that I will always do what I think is right for the people of our great country. Peter, we can win this race, but it won’t be easy. I need you with me as a Founding Donor today. Does a $10 donation, split between our Senate campaign and Wes Moore, fit in your budget?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20250730-1?refcode=em-20250730-1&refcode2=387_1086043_CQlLDl&akid=387%2E1086043%2ECQlLDl)**

We have work to do,
Roy Cooper

| | Hi friends,

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado now ranks among the [most expensive states to live](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), joining California on CNBC’s 2025 list—driven by skyrocketing insurance and housing costs. Ranchers are also pushing back against the state’s wolf program, accusing officials of [secretly releasing a problem pack on private land](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), leading to livestock attacks. At the Capitol,[ Medicaid’s ballooning enrollment](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is straining the budget. Meanwhile, parents across the state continue to [raise alarms about students identifying as “furries,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) while school officials, and the liberal media, stay silent.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** Federal officials are turning up the heat on [sanctuary states like Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) that shield criminal illegal immigrants. At the same time, activists are pressuring [banks to cut off ranchers and hunters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in a push for plant-based policies. And Mollie Hemingway warns the [anti-Trump conspiracy never ended](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with new disclosures likely to expose more top Obama officials and media collaborators.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** George Tristan says Trump’s second term is making history by [keeping promises](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—cutting taxes, reshaping trade, securing the border, and unleashing energy. He contrasts this with the left’s fixation on sanctuary laws and DEI, arguing voters rejected those priorities—and the world is following suit.
This is the Mountain Minute for Wednesday, July 30, 2025.

[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Rumors about students dressing as animals and disrupting classrooms have circulated throughout Colorado for years, sparking political fights, school board blowback and media denials. Some say the “furries in schools” narrative is a hoax pushed by conservative figures. But school records, parent testimony and disciplinary documents tell a more complicated story.
The saga gained momentum in 2022 when more than two dozen parents in Jefferson County bombarded school officials with concerns. Darlene Edwards, a mother whose 14-year-old autistic son attended a local middle school, told CBS Colorado her son returned home upset, describing classmates in animal costumes scratching, hissing, barking and crawling on all fours through the hallways.
Edwards’ niece added that students ate lunch with their faces buried in food and proudly called themselves “animal avengers.”

* Colorado’s Medicaid costs have soared due to 21 state laws expanding benefits since 2019, adding $858 million in annual spending—most of which is not federally reimbursed.
* Enrollment remains high post-pandemic, while new federal reforms phase out enhanced reimbursements and impose work requirements, straining rural hospitals already facing underpayments.
* Emergency Medicaid for noncitizens and unfunded state mandates have compounded pressures, prompting warnings that the state’s Medicaid model is fiscally unsustainable without serious reform.

body:
I’ve put forward detailed plans for lowering the cost of everything from housing and energy to health care, child care, and groceries — and I’m going to hit the ground running on Day 1 making them a reality.

| Peter, it’s been a few weeks since I won the Democratic nomination for governor of New Jersey. But this race is already a rollercoaster — we’ve seen an outpouring of grassroots support and also faced a barrage of right-wing attacks.

Today, I need your help to stop MAGA Republicans from flipping New Jersey red, and I’m humbly asking you to[ _**split $5 between my team and Laura Gillen to power our campaign to victory.**_ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112440922/560494327/139688667?refcode=BLU_EM_LGC_2025-07-30_2&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzIwMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmMwNGQ2MC03ZTZkLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2XkSQ9EHueYile0hrqAImDTb9sIcYOTVrRpSX2VotDw=)But if you’re not sure (which I understand!), here are five reasons I hope will convince you:

**1) New Jersey is not a safe Democratic state anymore** **— far from it.** The last governor’s election here? It was decided by 3%. New Jersey’s margin in the 2024 presidential election? 6%. The first polling in this race of the general election? It shows me leading my GOP opponent by only 3%.

**2) Donald Trump is going to do everything he can to defeat me in this race. He’s already endorsed my opponent, Jack Ciattarelli, and led a rally for him —** meaning MAGA money from all over the country is going to pour into Ciattarelli’s campaign.

**3) Unlike my opponent, I won’t ever hesitate to stand up to Trump when he attacks New Jersey families.** I’ve sworn an oath to the Constitution, and I’ve spent my career honoring it to the best of my ability every single day — before loyalty to any other politician or political party. Ciattarelli has already made clear that his number-one priority is staying in Trump’s good graces.

**4) My top priority as governor will be making life more affordable for New Jersey families.** I’ve put forward detailed plans for lowering the cost of everything from housing and energy to health care, child care, and groceries — and I’m going to hit the ground running on Day 1 making them a reality.

**5) The stakes of this race are high not only for New Jersey, but for the country.** This is our chance to show the entire nation that the people reject the Trump administration’s incompetence and authoritarianism. And it’s our chance to get started on a better path forward — one where we prioritize doing what’s best for working families over what’s best for billionaires and corrupt political allies. There is no more important bellwether ahead of 2026.

_**[If any of these reasons speaks to you, I hope you will split a $5 donation between my team and Laura Gillen to help me defeat my Trump-endorsed opponent in this incredibly competitive election to determine who leads our state for the next four years.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/112440923/560494328/139688667?refcode=BLU_EM_LGC_2025-07-30_2&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzIwMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmMwNGQ2MC03ZTZkLWYwMTEtOGRjOS02MDQ1YmRhOWQ5NmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2XkSQ9EHueYile0hrqAImDTb9sIcYOTVrRpSX2VotDw=)**_

**A short explanation of the court win above, this case was decided last September 2024, but the Supreme Court ruling in our favor at the time, said the final order would come at a later time. That happened at the end of June. More to Come this week.**

### The Fight for Fair Elections: A Personal Mission
When I began the effort to repeal Ranked Choice Voting (RCV) in Alaska, I knew it would be a challenge. But I was determined not to let our electoral process be twisted into a confusing system that leaves voters disempowered.My commitment went beyond Alaska. I wrote **three books** and created a **30-part animated video series** to expose the truth about RCV, distributing thousands of copies and making the videos free nationwide. I've also spent countless hours collaborating with grassroots leaders across the country, helping establish organizations now fighting RCV. My websites, **RCValert.org** and **RemoveRCV.com** , offer years of research, resources, and tools like RCV Election Simulators.This fight is personal. My own grandfather, a wise and hardworking man, couldn't understand the ranked choice ballot. If someone with his common sense was confused, I knew there was a fundamental flaw. That moment spurred me to draft Alaska's repeal initiative.We didn't have billionaire funding or political party backing. What we had was unwavering determination and the support of over **700 dedicated Alaskan volunteers**. We knocked on doors, braved the cold, and gathered over **42,000 signatures** —far exceeding the requirement—all without help from political insiders.I've also traveled nationwide, warning states like Idaho, Oregon, Arizona, and Florida about RCV's manipulative nature, funded by out-of-state billionaires.As expected, the political establishment fought us. The attorney who brought RCV to Alaska even sued to prevent our repeal initiative from appearing on the ballot. But we prevailed in both the Alaska Superior Court and the Alaska Supreme Court. They outspent us by a staggering **one hundred to one** , with millions flowing in from out-of-state organizations like Unite America and the Sixteen Thirty Fund, supported by figures like George Soros and Hansjorg Wyss.On Election Day, I was immensely proud. Not only had I fought RCV in Alaska for years, but seven other states where I'd been active decisively rejected it. Those rejections alone cost the pro-RCV lobby nearly **$150 million** between 2020 and 2024. Here in Alaska, despite our small population, it took nearly three weeks to get election results—a clear example of RCV's confusion and delay.Our repeal effort in Alaska came agonizingly close, falling short by just 743 votes after nearly three weeks of counting. But my resolve is unbroken. This fight is a warning to the entire country. We must maintain simple, clear, and honest elections, demanding voter ID and keeping out-of-state special interests out.I am incredibly proud of what we achieved in Alaska. We showed the nation what ordinary, hardworking people can accomplish when they stand firm. The fight isn't over—not in Alaska, and not anywhere freedom-loving Americans call home.**Stand with us! Let's protect our elections for Alaska and for America.**

Friend,

**Exhausted. Strapped. Angry.**
American workers are _fed up_. They’re working harder than ever – and are _more productive_ than ever – but they still can’t seem to get ahead.
The middle class is sick of paying for tax breaks for the ultrawealthy, while prices rise and they scrape by in a system that’s rigged against them.

But they’re not giving up. They’re organizing.
**Union support is at a 60-year high.** From Starbucks baristas to Amazon warehouse workers to Philadelphia sanitation crews, more Americans than ever are standing up to say:

**Our work matters. And we’re DONE being taken for granted.**
I started the Dignity of Work PAC to elect leaders who fight for working people – not corporate donors. But this is a big job, and we need all the help we can get.

Trump just gave his fossil fuel cronies everything they’ve ever wanted.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112442433/560499372/1328794144?refcode=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ms=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg3ZjE2NGZkLTgwNmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rM5Z89t15z7ORFUvS4vOyGvVJsgdWeaFCsnXqF96zJQ=&emci=875db52a-726d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&emdi=87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ceid=4823105)

I wish I could say I’m surprised. But when it comes to Donald Trump and his fossil fuel cronies, the hits just keep coming, and this is likely the worst, most harmful action yet. Yesterday, Trump’s hand-picked EPA chief, Lee Zeldin, announced a plan to revoke what’s known as **the endangerment finding.** It’s a 2009 scientific declaration that greenhouse gases pose a dangerous threat to public health, and it has given the government legal authority to combat the climate crisis. It’s a cornerstone of any future climate action our country could take. Zeldin is calling their proposal _“the largest deregulatory action in the history of the United States.”_ Without the endangerment finding, the EPA under any future president will lose its power to hold Big Polluters accountable or limit fossil fuel emissions. And this comes just days after the Trump administration announced it’s eliminating the EPA’s scientific research arm and firing hundreds of the scientists who test our air and water, track toxic chemicals, and protect our health. **[I know it’s exhausting. I feel it too. But every time they come for our future, we have to fight back. That means channeling our frustration into building political power in the places where it matters most. State by state, city by city, we can still elect climate leaders who will protect our communities from the damage at the federal level. Will you pitch in a few dollars before our critical fundraising deadline tomorrow to support JanePAC’s work to save our planet?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112442434/560499373/2105508926?refcode=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ms=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg3ZjE2NGZkLTgwNmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rM5Z89t15z7ORFUvS4vOyGvVJsgdWeaFCsnXqF96zJQ=)** Look, Trump can dismantle the science on paper, but the climate crisis is already here. It’s in the rising death toll from heatwaves. It’s in the floods sweeping away entire neighborhoods. It’s in the wildfires that rage longer and burn hotter every year. No political stunt can erase what’s happening outside our windows. **If Trump wants to tear down every climate protection we’ve fought for, then we’ll build a firewall that he can't touch by electing climate champions up and down the ballot — from state legislatures to city councils, county boards, and attorneys general. Every election matters.** But we can’t do it without you. These elections don’t win themselves. Climate champions don’t get on the ballot without grassroots support to combat the fossil fuel industry’s billions. **[So let me ask again: Will you pitch in before tomorrow’s deadline to help us hit our $30,000 goal and build the climate firewall we need to stop Trump and Big Oil in their tracks?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112442435/560499374/2105508926?refcode=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ms=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg3ZjE2NGZkLTgwNmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rM5Z89t15z7ORFUvS4vOyGvVJsgdWeaFCsnXqF96zJQ=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112442436/560499375/2105508926?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ms=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg3ZjE2NGZkLTgwNmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rM5Z89t15z7ORFUvS4vOyGvVJsgdWeaFCsnXqF96zJQ=) | [**DONATE $25**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112442437/560499376/2105508926?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&ms=ea.87f164fd-806d-f011-8dc9-6045bda9d96b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjg3ZjE2NGZkLTgwNmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=rM5Z89t15z7ORFUvS4vOyGvVJsgdWeaFCsnXqF96zJQ=)

clean_body: Trump just gave his fossil fuel cronies everything they’ve ever wanted. | I wish I could say I’m surprised. But when it comes to Donald Trump and his fossil fuel cronies, the hits just keep coming, and this is likely the worst, most harmful action yet. Yesterday, Trump’s hand-picked EPA chief, Lee Zeldin, announced a plan to revoke what’s known as the endangerment finding. It’s a 2009 scientific declaration that greenhouse gases pose a dangerous threat to public health, and it has given the government legal authority to combat the climate crisis. It’s a cornerstone of any future climate action our country could take. Zeldin is calling their proposal “the largest deregulatory action in the history of the United States.” Without the endangerment finding, the EPA under any future president will lose its power to hold Big Polluters accountable or limit fossil fuel emissions. And this comes just days after the Trump administration announced it’s eliminating the EPA’s scientific research arm and firing hundreds of the scientists who test our air and water, track toxic chemicals, and protect our health. = Look, Trump can dismantle the science on paper, but the climate crisis is already here. It’s in the rising death toll from heatwaves. It’s in the floods sweeping away entire neighborhoods. It’s in the wildfires that rage longer and burn hotter every year. No political stunt can erase what’s happening outside our windows. If Trump wants to tear down every climate protection we’ve fought for, then we’ll build a firewall that he can't touch by electing climate champions up and down the ballot — from state legislatures to city councils, county boards, and attorneys general. subject: Sixty Years of Medicaid: A Commitment Worth Defending

body:
Dear ,

Today marks sixty years since the creation of Medicaid, one of the most significant public health programs in our nation’s history. From the beginning, Medicaid has helped ensure that access to health care is not limited to the wealthy but available to those who need it most.

More than two million Virginians rely on Medicaid for care. In 2018, my predecessors serving in the Virginia General Assembly expanded access to this essential program in the Commonwealth in a bipartisan fashion, extending coverage to working families, children, older adults, and people with disabilities. That expansion has saved lives and strengthened communities.

Unfortunately, the progress made is now under attack. Federal legislators passed the Big Beautiful AWFUL Bill Act and President Donald Trump has signed it into law pushing for drastic cuts at the federal level that would strip coverage from more than three hundred thousand Virginians. These cuts will force the closure of rural hospitals, weaken maternal health care, reduce access to home care, and create serious gaps in Virginia's budget, all to fund additional tax breaks for the wealthiest Americans.

There are now fewer than one hundred days until the November election , and every seat in the Virginia House of Delegates will be on the ballot. Control of the chamber will determine whether we protect and strengthen Medicaid or allow it to be dismantled.

Can I count on you to donate $25 to support keeping the 25th District blue and help elect Democrats up and down the ballot?

DONATE TODAY [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/friendsofbriana-main]

I remain proud of the work we have done and deeply committed to protecting this critical program. Voters will have a clear choice this fall: to stand up for the health of our communities or to let decades of progress be undone.

Let us continue to move forward, together.
Yours in service,
Briana Sewell

Most of the emails will tell you it’s an important deadline, but they will rarely explain why these End-of-Month deadlines are so critical to a campaign’s success. That’s why I wanted to take a minute and break down why our Thursday deadline is so important and more than just a marketing gimmick. Democrats are outspending Republicans by historic margins across the country, in races that wouldn’t have been considered battleground races just a few years ago. They’re relying on a radical base of megadonors and extremist special interest groups to fuel their campaigns. We don’t have their base of extremist megadonors. We’re a grassroots-powered campaign. That means, to compete every ad and voter outreach campaign needs to be carefully planned, budgeted for, and executed. Months in advance, my campaign team sets specific fundraising monthly benchmarks to run the ads and target voters we need to secure victory. These fundraising targets allow my team to plan our winning voter outreach strategy, combating anything the Democrats throw at us. In a race this expensive and contentious, every End-of-Month fundraising deadline counts. One down month or missed deadline could permanently put us on the defensive, jeopardizing our Republican Majority. I know it doesn’t sound like a lot, but with the amount Democrats are spending against us, EVERY dollar matters. Even coming up a few dollars short means critical campaign operations will have to be scaled back. will give my team the resources they need to execute a winning campaign strategy to keep this seat in Republican hands. Peter,
Sixty years ago today, Medicaid was signed into law, one of the most important safety net programs our country has ever created. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_email-25q3?refcode=x_250730_medicaidanniversary_act]
Over the decades, millions of families have relied on Medicaid to get by when times were hard. It’s been a lifeline. A shield. A promise that no matter your zip code or income, you have a right to care.
And now, on its anniversary, Trump and his cronies are making a mockery of that promise.
Earlier this month, Donald Trump signed a devastating budget that would gut Medicaid and rip health care away from 17 million people. Experts are warning it could cause 50,000 unnecessary deaths every year.
Let me be clear: This policy is deadly.
I’ve fought Republicans tooth and nail over their attacks on our communities, and I’m not done yet. But I can’t do it alone. We need a movement of people who will rise up and say: We won’t go back. We won’t let them win.
We’re up against our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and every dollar helps power our fight to elect progressive champions who will protect Medicaid, defend everyday people, and expand access to care, not slash it. name: Lindsey Graham
subject: The American Dream isn’t just a slogan.
body:
This is my story, but it’s not so different for many Americans. |
---
I want to share something from the heart with you, Fellow American.

**_My story._**
It isn't one of glitz and glamour -- it's about hard work, loss, and fighting for what's right. I'm reaching out to tell you why I'm in this fight for our future, and why I need you with me.

Neither of my parents finished high school. But they were hardworking and determined that their children would surpass their achievements.

Most of my growing up happened on the main street of a small textile mill town. My parents had a business establishment -- a combination beer joint, restaurant, liquor store, and pool hall -- known as the Sanitary Cafe right on Main Street in Central, SC. We all lived in the back of the bar where we worked late into the evening, especially my mom, before heading off to bed in the backroom.

[](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=7e19f3f5880e4109af67e626f1554a2c&_e=-EpZUfxQ8sQt4yBMnz2z8XAxm0YilhWHRgD-kXmGdW_Fmk_GEUVD1kUW9vrm69STLS6YCIMOxmuyA_2GtPt3IWzonIJjr4Vgan17Zxj2-bjKJ9GeUzMiXONDbSH-x-JNzgmAxP83n8Zc56nC6FsTi_zE-fpVCZQygcZ8CimPv-WAf4wwxHtsO1WhynlVl4z0MpAcgMeK1cn7vXKqKNxk9weK0QRvDVm1ZVnukOT-oEd4SY3rEdc2WRkY7G2zYXCj46GhmDjkebQi7KMT7AXyRPVzYNDr1y7TQqoqVBpa8w6ll0HqKyLfHHtq6OjBBcC0M68WjCSNEDmwB6rrsppArVC6RYW4tdxFW5QyP5G5pxIwSm_QoLyKO56PV05mMmlLT3WRgp_8QegGPj839i_MW-DdFIjLl9H-AH7jhzbCt14l3sIx9FZ_roOXNNz2uZJKkHShvGkgpKvybsS2GFylH1GnXeI3GcONAmXdJNmnQdlkYAbhszaFSndlmqg04jXuCPh027yn2cM0eFCBct19K8thf2FAAg6otHyHFydiNQhuRJBqg_jPlcnuG4zJ1Nv0j_MwYCiP8GQ6yA2AOpC-mb07rEef7LRIoTy2J8q-DzLiQOBxY6LwFFNPwTR3Mj87qPO8dhdW8CHuSPP8X7ndYMei1sxqc3NrK3vOyMEozXbTJ_MYxGPtv3DNKKjEk85YV0lfv-BZAesnbu6PKKGvEW6JUI8xqNk8qOqRmn5cBz4%3D) I had no silver spoon in my mouth but I never felt I was missing out on something because I didn't live in a house like my friends did. I had a great life, and it was a great way to grow up.

I was the first in my family to attend college, but then life hit me hard. While I was in school, I lost my mom and dad within two years of each other. And just like that, I stepped up to help raise my 13-year-old sister, Darline, while coming back home on the weekends to help at our family business.

[](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=7e19f3f5880e4109af67e626f1554a2c&_e=-EpZUfxQ8sQt4yBMnz2z8XAxm0YilhWHRgD-kXmGdW_Fmk_GEUVD1kUW9vrm69STLS6YCIMOxmuyA_2GtPt3IWzonIJjr4Vgan17Zxj2-bjKJ9GeUzMiXONDbSH-x-JNzgmAxP83n8Zc56nC6FsTi_zE-fpVCZQygcZ8CimPv-WAf4wwxHtsO1WhynlVl4z0MpAcgMeK1cn7vXKqKNxk9weK0QRvDVm1ZVnukOT-oEd4SY3rEdc2WRkY7G2zYXCjfcSZEtYpXO64iupq6Gzyw_CJxxmWFzeYr296QsNgV-aTeI702EVXvljkgXaTFzwC0btS-QiG5ltsWdiDU6jIWJuHX_Gf_j-CbYu1TLOW4kiJXD9lVLthE3FuTneiXQ7IJvtvPsqKifoQuof5aOTfc7rjCc3PLo10iqrAH2BredK6ONOiUkcyc_7n80s_2xnpQ_snuWbXuC-qAGpi4_t7UnWlW9tKhaXhSKkpBJ-2NLVCxyblKvWYiOTTqknpZSlI8XeGstWeb5c4A47-oiBqYYl2xi6G66bEn0C2kHSR-PHUWUEDNgw-Ek57nd5lJpIwAALhifFzsx96joN67SoPJv8q1R6neA7SoiaAkfz-WxL-oKffDioyDSVIVhEuTRoDV3l3_xqtYQe1YV7kUmbye-rNhurC35cUunFMky6Rf_y_IHLvYxYhThnXyb67Skn6jILBwhnueJ01-MllMfP0GAKAYb_vLSw0R4bgyLdyE7A%3D) **Fellow American, I learned some tough lessons early on.**

After law school, I joined the U.S. Air Force as a Judge Advocate General, serving as a military prosecutor and defense attorney. Even after the people of South Carolina sent me to the United States Senate, I continued my service in the Air Force Reserves. I performed several short deployments in war zones like Afghanistan and Iraq, standing shoulder to shoulder with our brave men and women in uniform.

My story isn't all that different from yours or most people across this great country. I didn't have anything handed to me. I worked hard, grew up quickly, and took on big responsibilities.

**But what shaped me most was listening to the hard -working South Carolinians who'd come by our family business, sharing their hopes and struggles, or hearing the perspectives of my brave colleagues in the military.** _Whether I agreed with them or not, those conversations built my understanding of what Americans need and deserve._

Now, Fellow American, we all know our nation's in a tough spot -- we're divided, but there are some things we should agree on, plain and simple.

**🇺🇸 We need a country where you can raise your family without fear, where the streets are safe.**
**🇺🇸 We need a country where the American Dream isn't just a slogan.**
_It's alive, and every hard -working American has a real shot at it, no matter where they start._
**[That's what I'm fighting for every single day, Fellow American.](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=7e19f3f5880e4109af67e626f1554a2c&_e=-EpZUfxQ8sQt4yBMnz2z8XAxm0YilhWHRgD-kXmGdW_Fmk_GEUVD1kUW9vrm69STLS6YCIMOxmuyA_2GtPt3IWzonIJjr4Vgan17Zxj2-bjKJ9GeUzMiXONDbSH-x-JNzgmAxP83n8Zc56nC6FsTi_zE-fpVCZQygcZ8CimPv-WAf4wwxHtsO1WhynlVl4z0MpAcgMeK1cn7vXKqKNxk9weK0QRvDVm1ZVnukOT-oEd4SY3rEdc2WRkY7G2zYXCjK6m8kNUb4V6IL2ubTji7BB9l0l_qlAREuudfWchQxo_46Abv7M1__08oBCAWAeaAwpgsgMQWbI7K2RGO2xRkHPlkUx-UlsFvpDAuS9SEquBEPP9ngMP6rReYx-MycJlq09fso43h3LBJ7f5rFgr7sOdpO_2LXVOcDFoxe02a0TFHcWzZvUtky80-kL629J1ogK3J_a3Ent7XjERI215JEscwq6oh64DyR4Nlsk8BhkdLh-3ukmFv3ztBwyA7gs5XwnTCujVHIC-8VFTiqQ0aVO-NjmAgEOKlp1SwNeiWP43hly1M0HBU1Gwr0I_ec98QcDNJ5bHzyHTIw40rrPOi5hE8EVXBq4n_YCdiLQYrxbLnXyFw69jZBYdlYmVk3AUoRU3IIMfEA2cm04tbRT1TPU62cnYq7E6sH49C3PER68hkrhycG86Va_HhhNC4qhvlaPzGSPF73X59lzeJ_ii2HwqHVfJJ_ve0DVqvdhvIeak%3D)**

Sadly, there are folks in Washington, across the aisle, who don't see it that way. They're fine with open borders, allowing violent crime spill into our neighborhoods. They're okay with slapping higher taxes on hard-working folks like you, piling more burdens on your family. That isn't right, and I won't stand for it.

So I'm coming to you with a simple ask, Fellow American. If you've got a few dollars to spare, **[would you consider joining Team Graham to support my campaign?](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=7e19f3f5880e4109af67e626f1554a2c&_e=-EpZUfxQ8sQt4yBMnz2z8XAxm0YilhWHRgD-kXmGdW_Fmk_GEUVD1kUW9vrm69STLS6YCIMOxmuyA_2GtPt3IWzonIJjr4Vgan17Zxj2-bjKJ9GeUzMiXONDbSH-x-JNzgmAxP83n8Zc56nC6FsTi_zE-fpVCZQygcZ8CimPv-WAf4wwxHtsO1WhynlVl4z0MpAcgMeK1cn7vXKqKNxk9weK0QRvDVm1ZVnukOT-oEd4SY3rEdc2WRkY7G2zYXCjNV2LpV3twP3zs0R2HmKSs59wJdB4LdPJydtyT-zFVIvLQZVihSummfe_x7VLdlJtLt22vbmZslQZ-6TZM3K4MqZ9Avow-RaqAvU2Qkw5adpF-DGqqbrae3XDXfu8GRX-ekTHEBw10gOXH4RIZzcwCEs5Ffm9ctoXomT4GBr_H26RdT-wuM2C8MfHFfSEZ4ryaGH9tT2LRddqPjmFPdqlwFs8IRB3aKQq_2F2PbVk8sYFb1kGw-63Vt9VnhnwAfCk1x2etuJs3-tazVGK9llGnwERMCcqpLWw3gYrRJbaLU6UhVg0twTzhsRYGlWwIj6SPFjvCsCRmHNfyipQykKf2Gu8brOiqBDX5ZlfUmnTRTnZhpzH5PaTlJeVtCgedTWBGfCp4NGveb9RcwX9ouZzLXQ-r5fmfDS9KTZ-flhC6lJAXPRrom2VlyXckyTjPnnon90cz4bpA-v-U_4Jm30qUyFg3Jhqc3R4GVHTobzmdUw%3D)**

clean_body: This is my story, but it’s not so different for many Americans. | I want to share something from the heart with you, Fellow American. My story. It isn't one of glitz and glamour -- it's about hard work, loss, and fighting for what's right. I'm reaching out to tell you why I'm in this fight for our future, and why I need you with me. Neither of my parents finished high school. But they were hardworking and determined that their children would surpass their achievements. Most of my growing up happened on the main street of a small textile mill town. My parents had a business establishment -- a combination beer joint, restaurant, liquor store, and pool hall -- known as the Sanitary Cafe right on Main Street in Central, SC. We all lived in the back of the bar where we worked late into the evening, especially my mom, before heading off to bed in the backroom. I had no silver spoon in my mouth but I never felt I was missing out on something because I didn't live in a house like my friends did. I had a great life, and it was a great way to grow up. I was the first in my family to attend college, but then life hit me hard. While I was in school, I lost my mom and dad within two years of each other. And just like that, I stepped up to help raise my 13-year-old sister, Darline, while coming back home on the weekends to help at our family business. Fellow American, I learned some tough lessons early on. After law school, I joined the U.S. Air Force as a Judge Advocate General, serving as a military prosecutor and defense attorney. Even after the people of South Carolina sent me to the United States Senate, I continued my service in the Air Force Reserves. I performed several short deployments in war zones like Afghanistan and Iraq, standing shoulder to shoulder with our brave men and women in uniform. My story isn't all that different from yours or most people across this great country. I didn't have anything handed to me. I worked hard, grew up quickly, and took on big responsibilities. But what shaped me most was listening to the hard -working South Carolinians who'd come by our family business, sharing their hopes and struggles, or hearing the perspectives of my brave colleagues in the military. Whether I agreed with them or not, those conversations built my understanding of what Americans need and deserve. Now, Fellow American, we all know our nation's in a tough spot -- we're divided, but there are some things we should agree on, plain and simple. 🇺🇸 We need a country where you can raise your family without fear, where the streets are safe. 🇺🇸 We need a country where the American Dream isn't just a slogan. It's alive, and every hard -working American has a real shot at it, no matter where they start. Sadly, there are folks in Washington, across the aisle, who don't see it that way. They're fine with open borders, allowing violent crime spill into our neighborhoods. They're okay with slapping higher taxes on hard-working folks like you, piling more burdens on your family. That isn't right, and I won't stand for it. So I'm coming to you with a simple ask, Fellow American. If you've got a few dollars to spare, | Fellow American, I know we can build a country that keeps our communities safe, rewards hard work, and gives every American a chance to chase their dreams -- just like I did. Thank you for taking a minute to hear my story. I'm grateful for you. Peter ,
Trump and Governor Greg Abbott are moving quickly to rig the 2026 midterms by targeting five Democratic congressional seats in Texas with newly gerrymandered maps.

[_**Don’t stay on the sidelines — DONATE NOW to fund our work to stop gerrymandering in Texas, Ohio, and anywhere else Republicans try to take power from voters >>**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112443831/560504341/-246980373?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_EOM1_email_20250730-NDRC-Tier1-EOM1_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250730-NDRC-Tier1-EOM1_&utm_campaign=EOM1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjljYjM4YjU3LTg1NmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=x4uF6IcoUSKIcCELL8BsRnPGzZ5HlEmhD2hyIbv-b2o=) Peter — In Texas right now, we’re using every tool at our disposal to stop **an existential threat to our democracy.** That’s not an exaggeration when you look at the facts: Texas Republicans have called a special legislative session to gerrymander congressional districts because the president explicitly demanded they redraw the map so “we pick up five seats.” It doesn’t get much more blatantly anti-democracy than that. **So here’s what we’re doing about it —[and how your contribution today will help stop gerrymandering and power the movement for fair maps:](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112443832/560504342/-246980373?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_EOM1_email_20250730-NDRC-Tier1-EOM1_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250730-NDRC-Tier1-EOM1_&utm_campaign=EOM1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjljYjM4YjU3LTg1NmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=x4uF6IcoUSKIcCELL8BsRnPGzZ5HlEmhD2hyIbv-b2o=)**
* **Our affiliate, the National Redistricting Action Fund, is funding digital ad campaigns and hosting events with our grassroots network** to give Texans the tools they need to contact their legislators and sign up to testify against gerrymandering at public hearings.

* **We’re helping to grow the wave of grassroots opposition to a potential gerrymander — highlighted by hundreds of citizens showing up to the first public hearing about the redraw to testify against another gerrymander.** As Rep. Joaquin Castro (TX-20) pointed out in his testimony, not a single congressional Republican showed up to support the redraw. Even Republicans responsible for past gerrymanders in Texas are warning that this is going too far.

* **Next month, President Obama and Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi will join Attorney General Eric J. Holder** to help NDRC and our affiliates marshal more resources for the fight ahead in Texas and other states where Republicans are looking to gerrymander.

Texans are rightly angry about these attacks on fair representation. And they are showing up to express their opposition to this cynical plot. **We’ll be right there alongside them.[Donate now to fund our comprehensive efforts to stop Republican gerrymandering in Texas and across the country.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/112443833/560504343/-246980373?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_EOM1_email_20250730-NDRC-Tier1-EOM1_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250730-NDRC-Tier1-EOM1_&utm_campaign=EOM1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjljYjM4YjU3LTg1NmQtZjAxMS04ZGM5LTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=x4uF6IcoUSKIcCELL8BsRnPGzZ5HlEmhD2hyIbv-b2o=)** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

That’s not an exaggeration when you look at the facts: Texas Republicans have called a special legislative session to gerrymander congressional districts because the president explicitly demanded they redraw the map so “we pick up five seats.” It doesn’t get much more blatantly anti-democracy than that. We’re helping to grow the wave of grassroots opposition to a potential gerrymander — highlighted by hundreds of citizens showing up to the first public hearing about the redraw to testify against another gerrymander. As Rep. Joaquin Castro (TX-20) pointed out in his testimony, not a single congressional Republican showed up to support the redraw. Holder to help NDRC and our affiliates marshal more resources for the fight ahead in Texas and other states where Republicans are looking to gerrymander. # [#]Peter, Marie is making headlines with her people-first, local-first approach to her work in Congress – take a look:
Front Porch Republic
The Localist at the Capitol: A Conversation with Marie Gluesenkamp Perez:
“We need a balance between chasing the most pressing symptoms, and a longer and proportional focus on the underlying, the root causes of those symptoms. So maybe instead of talking about ‘economic’ versus ‘cultural’ issues, you talk more about root causes versus symptoms.”
The Nation
If Democrats Want to Appeal to Rural America, They Need to Talk Like a Neighbor:
“Polls and focus groups are useful but no substitute for people who live and breathe un-rarefied air every day of the week...[Voters] appreciate that these politicians...like Marie Gluesenkamp Perez...are genuinely ‘for’ something.”
Compact Magazine:
“Ever since Gluesenkamp Perez’s 2022 upset, national outlets have leaned on familiar labels to characterize her—’moderate,’ ‘centrist’... But Gluesenkamp Perez isn’t splitting the difference between two poles so much as she is working from a different starting point, centered on repair, ownership, and trade work.”
(On her amendment to establish a cognitive acuity standard for Members of Congress)
KGW
“There’s a real appetite for transparency and good governance.”
Axios
“Real respect for our communities and the body here is [being] willing to have these honest, candid and difficult conversations...It’s clear people want systemic reform. They want accountability.”
The New York Times
These Younger Democrats Are Sick of Their Party’s Status Quo
“A number of prominent younger Democrats with records of winning tough races are forming a new group with big ambitions to remake their party’s image, recruit a new wave of candidates and challenge political orthodoxies they say are holding the party back...[pushing the Democratic Party to] better address the issues that feel most urgent in voters’ lives...Members include Marie Gluesenkamp Perez of Washington.”

Marie is upholding her promise to listen and bring all of our voices to the table, even when that means making tough decisions.

But, that fierce independence and loyalty to community has made her a target for far-right extremists who want to replace her with someone who puts politics above people.

They’ve already started launching attacks against Marie in hopes of flipping WA-03, and we need to fight back. Will you rush in $10 right away to help get our fundraising back on track? BCJ: State Bills Would Require Passport or Birth Certificate to Register to Vote [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073025_2&amount=25]
Team,
We've told you that voter I.D. laws are unfairly biased against people of color, young people, and unmarried women. However, across the country, states are introducing bills to make these laws even MORE restrictive at an alarming rate.
The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice has the details: “ Lawmakers in at least 27 states have introduced...bills in 2025 that would require some or all voters to show citizenship documents to vote .” Not just when you register, but every single time you show up to cast a ballot.
While citizenship is required to vote, rigorous research shows time and again that instances of votes cast by non-citizens are extremely rare. At least 21 million citizens, however, do not have immediate access to the I.D. documents these laws would demand, including 3.1 million voters who lack documents entirely.
The suppressive SAVE Act is stalled in Congress. So opponents of voting rights have turned to the states. These bills aren’t motivated by a desire for free and fair elections – they’re just another voter suppression tactic.
We need your help to defend the right to vote in these 27 states and beyond. Will you chip in with $25 or whatever you can today to help us fight back against voter suppression and intimidation? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=073025_2&amount=25]

The problem is not only that these bills would block millions of Americans from voting, but also that these requirements to vote are a massive burden for election officials and many voters alike.
These intimidating requirements also come alongside other suppressive policies stocked into these bills: Mandatory voter purges, reduced early voting, closing polling places, restrictions on mail-in ballots, and so much more.
We need to speak with one loud, clear voice and tell every state legislature: We won't stand for any of these suppressive policies. Not now, not ever.

Peter,

Nearly 60,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been murdered by Israel's
genocide, with more starving by the day or being shot by Israeli forces
while trying to get food to survive.

The same Democratic politicians who spent two years denying Israel's
atrocities and condemning peaceful protesters are now speaking up — but
let’s be clear: their tweets and statements don’t mean a thing if they’re
still backed by AIPAC and sending more weapons to the IDF.

It’s a moral failure when Marjorie Taylor Greene, of all people, can call
a genocide a genocide before hundreds of AIPAC-backed Democrats find the
spine to do so.

AIPAC is already pumping money into 2026 races to hold its grip on
Washington and maintain unconditional U.S. support for Israel. A new
report from Sludge found they already spent more than $12.7 million on
federal candidates in just the first half of this year.

AIPAC’s PAC was the largest PAC contributor to federal candidates in the
2024 election cycle, and it looks like they’re preparing to spend even
more this time around: their “total spending in the first half of 2025
represents an increase of more than 80% compared with the first six months
of 2023.”

If Democrats want to truly stand on the right side of history and end
Israel’s ethnic cleansing of Palestinians, they must cut ties with AIPAC
and start voting to hold Israel accountable. If they don’t, then they
should be primaried next year.

and Delia Ramirez have all introduced and supported legislation to end the

| | Peter – Sixty years ago, Medicare and Medicaid were officially enacted into law.

Today, Medicare and Medicaid cover nearly 1 in 3 Americans, including hundreds of thousands here in California. These critical social safety nets have helped keep countless individuals and their families afloat for generations, including millions of seniors, pregnant women, and people with disabilities – and they are important resources we can’t afford to lose.

I’ve always stood against Republicans’ attempts to slash funding for these programs, but **the latest Medicaid cuts from Trump and the GOP majorities in Congress are set to leave millions of Americans without health care coverage.**

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1su84fbb7kyzxv23cjb9lkrfm447e0amt8xcc24tub2tj8c5e9bnvd5yqsa5r70fbacwb2s2svo0b3n0w3wu78corm6rp1unb2mi5915jww307g97qcagxm69rxs7z5r7st44rh59t&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t08e0m&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t08e0m&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t08e0m&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=rc6qmltxol1su84fbb7kyzxv23cjb9lkrfm447e0amt8xcc24tub2tj8c5e9bnvd5yqsa5r70fbacwb2s2svo0b3n0w3wu78corm6rp1unb2mi5915jww307g97qcagxm69rxs7z5r7st44rh59t&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t08e0m&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=t08e0m&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
https://www.aacfpennsylvania.org [https://www.aacfpennsylvania.org]
Hi Peter,
We’re celebrating a powerful step forward for the environment here in Pennsylvania: state officials have issued criminal charges against the company responsible for one of the largest methane leaks in recent U.S. history. [https://www.alleghenyfront.org/pa-issues-criminal-charges-against-equitrans-for-massive-2022-gas-leak/] This 2022 disaster that polluted the air and water and put countless families at risk.
This is a big deal. For too long, corporations have been allowed to poison our communities without consequence. But this time, Pennsylvania is sending a clear message: if you pollute our neighborhoods, you will be held accountable.
When we asked Asian Americans across Pennsylvania what they wanted to see in their communities, an overwhelming 89% said they support stronger penalties for companies that pollute and poison our people [https://aacfpennsylvania.org/rooted-in-justice/] . We couldn’t agree more. Our communities deserve clean air, safe water, and healthy neighborhoods. We should hold these companies accountable and do more to protect people from future harm.
If you agree, sign our petition to support the Rooted in Justice: Environmental Agenda from Asian Americans in Pennsylvania. [https://secure.everyaction.com/ZOmr3eWNxkaUIaz3qnfOSg2?contactdata=EGWQKvoKick3czfsL6A1f+P7I515/LvkOGuNVlN4hb6rEmp3guhxsQD+3n5ivqoEl0wP5ZK2RXWhD5lINyQfkSVjW/lAQ33h/8PLL1ZjTnVfBpW587pOKDzltggY0CA9S+KEA75FVYiqTBVYIf4TZiFWsoYOLHl/6gmBRbpzS5Y=] This is a bold vision for a safer, healthier future for all of us created by our communities.

Peter,

Federal judges — and now a federal appeals court — have ruled that Donald
Trump’s executive order attempting to end birthright citizenship is
unconstitutional.^1

This ruling affirms what we already knew: The 14th Amendment guarantees
citizenship to all born in the U.S., regardless of their parents’
immigration status.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250730-1-movement.r5UFPW&refcode=em20250730-1453&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1453%2E342411%2Eqeo9Vh ]CNN Politics: Trump's effort to end birthright citizenship could have
taken effect this weekend. Lower courts are continuing to block it

executive order — a blatant attack on the Constitution. The Supreme Court
avoided ruling on the constitutionality of the order, focusing instead on
whether lower courts could issue nationwide injunctions.

Thankfully, federal courts stepped up, ruled Trump’s order
unconstitutional, and upheld the block on its enforcement. But this fight
is far from over.

The Trump administration is trying a new tactic to undermine birthright
citizenship — introducing requirements that could force parents of
newborns to prove their immigration status before obtaining a U.S.
passport or Social Security number for their children.^2

protect immigrant communities — but we need the strength of this
grassroots team to help keep the pressure on. That’s where you come in.

I'm an alpha male who has domain over my wife. Here's why I was scared
during my entire trip to New York City.

by Charlie Kirk
### **DAVID SHUSTER VIDEO, EXCLUSIVELY FOR YOU!**
_**Watch as David Shuster shows how dumb-dumb Trump tries to bury the Epstein story but just add a flame-thrower to the fire!**_
[](https://substack.com/redirect/8dedd373-6c29-4f7a-a152-ca5a37d3cbfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### **Cliff 's Note: **
Hey folks, today we have a column below promoting a frightening but essential documentary for you to view. The column is by my pal Kris Goldsmith, and it _had to be shared_ _today_. _Germany, my friends, is now needed to publicly expose**our Nazis**_ , as [our monopoly media refuses](https://substack.com/redirect/95cae8e6-45a4-4248-96f8-a425aff4d9c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), because they're [corporate automatons](https://substack.com/redirect/f273cc92-2578-45af-897f-7309a7b64ccd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
A few words, then I give you to Kris' powerful post on the [cross-pyromaniac incel ](https://substack.com/redirect/77e885a7-4e7f-4a55-8293-42a5ea1da37f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)complex. Last night, Sen. Corey Booker called out fellow Dems for not fighting the ["authoritarian" Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/8cd4f4a7-29bc-4bfd-ada3-8240f1086ab0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Good! I don't like ripping Dems, [but masked men kidnap](https://substack.com/redirect/bdb55c09-cb0f-413e-8398-25d95105d562?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) us, a President's steals funds put aside for those hurting in blue states, to give to states that voted for the gaudy, Hannibal-Lecter-loving pimp. And 2,897 [more atrocities](https://substack.com/redirect/bdb55c09-cb0f-413e-8398-25d95105d562?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
It isn't normal. _Please act and speak like_ _you get this_!
The Senate must provide "unanimous consent" to move forward on items, so one holdout can slow the Senate to a crawl. MAGA, as you can imagine, used this more times than Mike Johnson put on infra-red goggles to monitor his son's porn.
But Dems are nice! _Well, stop!_ Sen. Booker did, saying what was necessary about Democratic "complicity" if they didn't stand up to [the cretinous Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/d44fc46e-cc29-459a-9f1f-46e342eabcb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (video below). We need this from other proven Senate fighters--Chris Murphy, Elizabeth Warren, Sheldon Whitehouse, Tammy Duckworth, Brian Schatz. Use your leverage [to stop Trump from robbing us](https://substack.com/redirect/02106d00-be26-4915-bf2a-168a8d6429da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), burying [the Epstein story](https://substack.com/redirect/9f23cc61-73ed-4bdb-8550-199426173eb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), sending masked Mugabes [to kidnap children](https://substack.com/redirect/55612907-7401-4bb1-9287-e7f1abe2b3a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You wanna win, and stop this chaos and catastrophe? **Show urgency**.
Show that you're _as horrified and furious about Trump 's treachery[ as we are](https://substack.com/redirect/d64c37b9-c351-4f2b-a1a8-12c56e7a75ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)! _Sen. Booker just gave you a roadmap. And[ more help](https://substack.com/redirect/0cf5cfe7-e4a5-45e3-8396-55240dbe263c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is on the way! Now is long past time!
[](https://substack.com/redirect/e0b8b2fa-0129-42f4-ba0e-9a6a27dd30f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
