# **Racism, Hatred & Terror: a Network of Right Wing Extremists**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c1f2c132-4d78-4b2e-a059-34e9b443a4a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**by Kris Goldsmith**
### **The film opens with footage that most decent people wouldn 't recognize, but that I can't ever unsee.**
It's a compilation of first-person footage recorded by white supremacist mass shooters--terror meant to be livestreamed, copied, and celebrated. One of those scenes is the Buffalo helmet-camera video, filmed as he carried out a massacre at a grocery store. Another, approaches a Synagogue. Yet another, murderer breaks into a Mosque. They follow the same formula: hate-fueled violence made for digital distribution. Some of us in antifascist research watched these events live as they proliferated in real-time across far-right spaces on the internet. All of of us have seen these clips repackaged, glorified, and reposted by extremists countless times ever since.
This is the first image _World White Hate_ gives us. Not because it's gratuitous, but because it's honest. The documentary [doesn't look away from what fascist violence actually looks like](https://substack.com/redirect/7db7fe5f-22c4-44a3-8a55-0221b67a464d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in our time. It shows how terrorism in the U.S. is now designed for viral replication. It shows how the ideology behind the trigger pulls is being exported across the globe. And it shows what those of us trying to stop it are up against.
Over the past several years, I've collaborated with investigative journalists and documentary filmmakers to expose the [growing threat of organized fascism](https://substack.com/redirect/18605f93-e4fb-45d0-a050-d45d46be0dd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the United States. Many of those projects were shelved before release--or found themselves without mainstream distribution partners--not because the material lacked substance, but because American media institutions lacked the political will to support them.
_[World White Hate](https://substack.com/redirect/c1f2c132-4d78-4b2e-a059-34e9b443a4a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , a three-part documentary produced by German filmmakers and recently released internationally via ARTE, stands as one of the few projects that made it to the public. I appear in the latter two episodes, alongside other American veterans and antifascist organizers. Together, we provide firsthand accounts of the crisis and share our strategies for resisting it.
This documentary is unflinching. It doesn't sanitize or soften the truth. It depicts the violence, [the ideology](https://substack.com/redirect/770b946b-f72b-428b-86a8-7b761485beb8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the networks fueling this global movement. That honesty is precisely why it would never have aired on American television.
This isn't a matter of market dynamics. **It 's a matter of fear**. Even before the 2024 election cycle intensified, [executives across streaming platforms, studios, and legacy media](https://substack.com/redirect/eb6f7c03-8bba-4b09-bfa7-a784da4ec2a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) were already anticipating the consequences of a second Trump presidency. Rather than provoke the wrath of MAGA operatives or risk political retaliation, many chose to look away. _World White Hate_ was caught in that silence--a film too direct, too damning, too true for an American audience.
So it was German journalists who took the lead. They traveled to the U.S., collected the evidence, and brought it back to Europe to warn their own country about the transnational rise of fascism.
_**They recognized something our country continues to evade: that the United States is no longer merely vulnerable to far-right extremism --we're exporting it.**_
We are [a global hub of white supremacist propaganda](https://substack.com/redirect/4db03826-d636-4742-8c86-6f8f509f6365?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), organizing, and insurgent ideology.
The fascists are now in power in the United States--and they're systematically dismantling the already-meager structures meant to counter violent white supremacist extremism. With Donald Trump in the White House and J.D. Vance as vice president, [federal agencies are adopting nationalist memes as policy, concentrating power, and redirecting resources](https://substack.com/redirect/18605f93-e4fb-45d0-a050-d45d46be0dd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) toward repressive enforcement.
Government social-media accounts are pushing white-nationalist and deportation memes--like "Alligator Alcatraz"--that celebrate cruelty toward migrants.
ICE has expanded into [the nation's largest paramilitary apparatus](https://substack.com/redirect/55612907-7401-4bb1-9287-e7f1abe2b3a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). A landmark MAGA megabill earmarked $150 billion for immigration enforcement through 2029, with roughly $75 billion going directly to ICE--exceeding the budgets of the FBI, DEA, ATF, and U.S. Marshals combined.
FEMA funds intended for disaster relief are being redirected to new detention infrastructure--concentration camps designed to be dangerous and to treat migrants as less-than-human.
Meanwhile, key congressional committees--dominated by MAGA loyalists--are [stripping money from public education, scientific research, and public broadcasting,](https://substack.com/redirect/0cf5cfe7-e4a5-45e3-8396-55240dbe263c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) while ICE grows unchecked.
[Progressive institutional funders are failing to meet this escalation](https://substack.com/redirect/5e3e9cf9-3254-4e60-aca6-9b49a96506ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Instead of scaling nationwide offensive and defensive antifascist community infrastructure, they continue investing in endless "convenings" and "scenario-plannings" that leave frontline investigators under-protected, under‐paid, and burned out.
_**Money is continuously burned in a cycle of paying those who virtue-signal the hardest, without supporting the operations and operators necessary to actually bring the fight to the fascists.**_
This has been the perpetual challenge of my own nonprofit organizations, [Task Force Butler Institute](https://substack.com/redirect/888aecea-02e4-45c4-b2fa-0ad4d6ace323?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and Veterans Fighting Fascism. **Our record speaks for itself: our research has facilitated the arrests, convictions, and multi-million-dollar judgements against the neo-Nazis who threaten vulnerable populations.**
**But our capacity to preempt violence, support survivors, and stabilize threat-research operations weakens every day.**
This is not alarmism. As _Foreign Affairs_ reported in 2023, the United States has become "the exemplar of far-right extremism." American-origin conspiracy theories and manifestos are turning up in violent attacks around the world--from New Zealand to Slovakia to Brazil. The so-called "great replacement" theory has entered mainstream discourse. [Calls for accelerationist violence are now a fixture ](https://substack.com/redirect/7c9c5447-9021-4ad9-96aa-d3099542fdd8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)of far-right strategy. And American veterans--people trained and trusted by the state--are among the primary targets of fascist recruitment.
_[World White Hate](https://substack.com/redirect/c1f2c132-4d78-4b2e-a059-34e9b443a4a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ pulls all of this into focus. [It strips away the euphemisms and false equivalencies](https://substack.com/redirect/ac34937c-a83b-4a89-80fb-95ee0b531a0f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that usually accompany conversations about political violence in the U.S. It reveals the inner workings of fascist movements and the tactics of those of us organizing against them. [It doesn't ask viewers to remain neutral](https://substack.com/redirect/eb6f7c03-8bba-4b09-bfa7-a784da4ec2a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It demands they choose a side.
After the 2024 election, director Dirk Laabs told me my interview "hit exactly the right points." **I take no pride in that. I wish this film had already been rendered obsolete**. But it hasn't.[ The threats it depicts are accelerating, not fading](https://substack.com/redirect/f27be2db-a4ab-47b7-b519-bf5251f6904b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Whether or not this documentary ever finds a distributor in the United States, one thing remains true: if you want to understand where we're headed--and how to stop it--**you need to watch this film. And you need to share it**.

Our democracy depends on a simple truth: elections are powered by people—and they must be protected.
Every single voter who casts a ballot in an election is essential to our democracy. And in each election, poll workers make it all happen. But now, they’re under fire.
Consider this:

* Federal directives can intimidate or divert resources away from secure, state-run systems.
* When we lose control over our own elections, voter confidence crumbles .

Our election workers have never been more under threat. So please, join me in my efforts to defend election workers and our entire election system. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?refcode=250730em-targeting]

Over the past few months, Trump and Republicans have created a smokescreen of lies to confuse voters about their intentions to slash Medicaid.

It's a mid-decade redistricting scheme that would gerrymander Texas to give Republicans 30 seats versus just 8 for Democrats. And now, a Florida Congressman wants to bring that same corrupt scheme here to the Sunshine State. **Rep. Hey folks,
Don Lemon couldn't make it this week, but we didn't miss a beat--Mike Madrid jumped in for an absolutely electric conversation. We covered everything from Trump's twisted pardon plans to the moral edge of redistricting--and I've never felt more urgency around the choices we're facing. This is a must-watch for anyone trying to make sense of the moment.
Here's what we got into:
* **[00:01:24] Trump and Diddy, and the Epstein smoke screen:** Mike and I dig into Trump's disturbing pattern of pardoning the unpardonable--and how it ties into a broader attempt to deflect from the Epstein fallout.
* **[00:04:44] The cracks in Trump 's base and the midterm ripple effect:** Why independent voters are finally recoiling, and how Democrats can capitalize--if we don't lose the plot.
* **[00:07:49] Texas Republicans ' latest gerrymandering power grab:** We unpack the new GOP-drawn maps and what it means when four of five new seats are Hispanic-majority--spoiler: it's not what they think.
* **[00:13:12] Do Democrats fight dirty --or just fight smart?** A fiery back-and-forth on the redistricting dilemma in California and what it means for the soul of the party.
* **[00:25:00] Filibusters, court-packing, and the existential playbook:** Where do we draw the line between principle and power? This segment is raw, honest, and not for the faint-hearted.

This is the kind of conversation that makes it impossible to look away. If you're feeling politically homeless, disillusioned, or just pissed off--you'll feel seen here. But more than that, you'll walk away with clarity and purpose.

name: Chris Pappas
subject: Calculated cruelty
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
I need you in this fight with me.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=1679%2E582294%2EN7Pzfc)
Day after day Donald Trump and his MAGA base are reaching new lows.
They’ve launched a full-scale assault on working families — right here in New Hampshire and across the country.
I’ve been traveling across the Granite State, and I’m hearing about the same issue again and again: Trump’s _Big Ugly Bill._
Let me be clear: There’s nothing beautiful about it.
This bill is a massive giveaway to the ultra-wealthy — and **it threatens food assistance for 76,000 Granite Staters** who rely on the SNAP program just to put food on the table.
These are families, seniors, veterans, and kids — people doing everything right but still struggling to make ends meet.
And Donald Trump wants to take away their groceries to pay for another billionaire tax break.
This isn’t just cruel. It’s calculated.
Let me show you what the _Big Ugly Bill_ really looks like:
> 💡 Hundreds of dollars more on your utility bills...
>
> 🏢 Thousands of jobs at risk...
>
> 🩺 Millions of Americans kicked off their health care...
>
> 🍎 Billions slashed from food assistance...
>
> 💰 And trillions added to the national debt...
All for **_massive tax cuts for the richest Americans and tax giveaways for Big Pharma._**
This is not what leadership looks like. It’s what corruption looks like.
And it doesn’t stop there.
Our small businesses — the backbone of New Hampshire’s economy — are getting hammered by Trump’s reckless trade war. I introduced legislation to shield our Main Street economy from these harmful tariffs. It’s a commonsense fix that would help small business owners and their customers.
But guess what? Republicans in Congress are standing in the way.
They’d rather protect Trump’s political agenda than stand up for small business owners in places like Nashua, Conway, or Laconia. That’s not who I am. I was born and raised in Manchester. I went to public schools, and I own a small business here.
**New Hampshire isn’t just where I’m from — it’s shaped who I am, and it’s why I’m in this fight.** And I’m running for Senate because I believe every Granite Stater deserves a fair shot.
That means lowering costs, protecting health care, and making sure our economy works _for everyone_ — not just billionaires.
But it’s clear that Donald Trump is more focused on protecting the wealthy and powerful than lowering costs for Americans. _The Wall Street Journal_ just reported that the Justice Department informed Donald Trump — _back in May_ — that his name appears in the Epstein files. And what did Republicans do? They shut down Congress to stop those files from being released.
This is outrageous. The American people deserve the truth. They deserve transparency. That’s what Trump _promised_ in his last campaign. And if this administration won’t come clean, Congress must act to get those files ourselves.
**Make no mistake: Republicans aren’t interested in justice.**
That’s why I’m speaking out — and stepping up.
Because in 2026 **New Hampshire will be one of the most competitive Senate races in the country.** Republicans are gearing up to target this seat as a top pickup opportunity.
Scott Brown has already jumped in. Another Republican has joined him. And now we’re hearing reports that Donald Trump is trying to recruit yet another MAGA loyalist into the race.
They’ll throw everything they have at us — but we’ve beaten the odds before, and I know we can do it again. I’ve won four elections in one of the toughest swing districts in America. I know what it takes to win here:_a strong grassroots movement and people-powered support._
That’s where you come in.
Unlike the other side, I’m not funded by right-wing special interests. This campaign is powered by people like you — folks chipping in what they can, when they can. It’s not flashy, but it works.
**Right now we’re facing a critical end-of-month deadline on July 31, and we’re still $9,389 short of our $20,000 goal.** If we fall behind now, we risk losing ground we can’t make up.
[**I’m asking you directly: Can I count on you to chip in $5 today toward our goal?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250730_2_eomlongform?refcode=em20250730-1679&amount=5&refcode2=1679_582294_N7Pzfc&akid=1679%2E582294%2EN7Pzfc)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_20250730_2_eomlongform?amount=5&refcode=em20250730-1679&refcode2=1679_582294_N7Pzfc&akid=1679%2E582294%2EN7Pzfc)**
This isn’t just about one Senate seat.
It’s about protecting our values. It’s about defending working families. And it’s about building a future where every Granite Stater has the freedom and opportunity to succeed.
Thanks for being in this fight with me. I’ll never stop fighting for you.
With gratitude,
Chris
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2026. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_cp_footer&refcode=em20250730-2?t=2&refcode2=1679_582294_N7Pzfc&akid=1679%2E582294%2EN7Pzfc)**

Dear Fellow Conservative, I’m writing to you today because the polls show that a Republican CAN win in California—and because I need your help to make it happen. But before I share the good news and the bad news, let me introduce myself. My name is Steve Hilton, and I’m running to be the next Governor of California to bring back freedom, opportunity, and common sense. [](%24%7BRecipient.Base_URL%7D?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=EM&utm_campaign=%24%7BRecipient.SendDate%7D_BDG_%24%7BRecipient.Sender%7D_%24%7BRecipient.Content%7D&utm_term=%24%7BRecipient.client%7D)[](%24%7BRecipient.Base_URL%7D?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=EM&utm_campaign=%24%7BRecipient.SendDate%7D_BDG_%24%7BRecipient.Sender%7D_%24%7BRecipient.Content%7D&utm_term=%24%7BRecipient.client%7D)[](%24%7BRecipient.Base_URL%7D?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=EM&utm_campaign=%24%7BRecipient.SendDate%7D_BDG_%24%7BRecipient.Sender%7D_%24%7BRecipient.Content%7D&utm_term=%24%7BRecipient.client%7D)[](%24%7BRecipient.Base_URL%7D?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=EM&utm_campaign=%24%7BRecipient.SendDate%7D_BDG_%24%7BRecipient.Sender%7D_%24%7BRecipient.Content%7D&utm_term=%24%7BRecipient.client%7D)[To make **California Golden Again** **and free our great state from 15-years of Democrat failures.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Thanks to the support of patriots like you, our grassroots movement is already gaining steam. We’re getting the message out, racking up endorsements from the strongest leaders in the conservative movement, and driving the Democrat establishment into a panic! And friend, the good news is I’m **LEADING** the race for California Governor according to a new statewide poll!
---
| | [ **CHECK OUT THE POLL** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Leading OUTRIGHT among the declared candidates, with upwards of **27%** of the vote! **Republicans and undecided voters lean heavily towards us** , and we are **outperforming the declared Democrats in the field** like Katie Porter. And that’s on top of polling that shows HALF of California voters would consider voting for a Republican in 2026. This poll confirms what I’m hearing every day from voters across the state: Californians want new leadership and are ready to end the 15 years of one-party failure. **But my friend, the bad news is that _Kamala Harris_ is waiting in the wings swoop in and try to take this race from us... ** **** **** If and when she enters the race, she could consolidate all the Democrat vote and push me into second place. She comes armed with liberal mega donors, unions, and the whole Democrat machine behind her—and they think they can buy this race. We know their plan—instead of laying out a vision to improve the lives of Californians, they will spend millions in attack ads against me, my voters, and our movement to Make California Golden Again. They will do anything to change the conversation away from their failures... **Away from $8 gas prices...** **Away from the rising crime and unsafe streets...** **Away from their war on single-family homes...** **Away from Kamala’s failed presidential campaign...** **Away from her failed Vice Presidency...** You and I can’t let them. **
**Thanks to the grassroots support we’ve received the polling shows we are already within striking distance of Harris if she joins the race – and with your help, we can close the gap.[**Will you chip in $6, $26 or a donation of any amount today?**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[ **DONATE** ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Your support will help us fund ads, host town halls across the state, knock on thousands of doors, and get our Make California Golden Again message out to as many voters as possible. I’m going to be out on the campaign trail nonstop, putting everything I have into the state I love — **can I count on you to help me do it?** My friend with your help we can end 15 years of one-party failure and restore the promise of this state.
---
Thank you in advance for your support. Steve Hilton Candidate for Governor of California.
---
| | **P.S.** I’m leading the race, but Kamala Harris could change everything. [**Chip in today to keep our momentum going.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
# Meet Steve Hilton
---
I love California so much. I moved to the Bay Area over a decade ago. I’ve raised my family here, taught at Stanford, started a business, written books, hosted a TV show ... lived the California dream. It’s my home, in the deepest sense. I’m a proud American, and an incredibly proud Californian too. But I’ve never forgotten where I came from. My parents were immigrants – they fled communism in Hungary to start a new life in England. In a free country. I appreciate exactly what that means. We didn’t have much money. My mother worked in a shoe store, my stepfather worked construction. My dad, who died when I was a kid, was the goalie for the Hungarian national ice hockey team. In 2012 we moved to California. I hosted a TV show — The Next Revolution with Steve Hilton — and podcasts: California Rebel Base, The Steve Hilton Show, Big Ideas Book Club. Through my policy organization, Golden Together, I’ve set out the changes we need to make to get this state back on track. Over the last few years, I’ve traveled the state, meeting people from all walks of life and backgrounds, in every part of California. I’ve spent time with business owners and workers in every industry, struggling with the absolute nightmare it’s become to start and grow a company here. I’ve seen the struggles so many Californians face raising a family given the unbelievable costs of living here. To make real change happen in government, you need the ability to think differently, the courage to challenge establishment groupthink and the conviction to follow through. That’s what I will bring to this job – to the urgent necessity of restoring the California Dream for everyone, and making this beautiful state, that we love so much, truly Golden Again.

I hosted a TV show — The Next Revolution with Steve Hilton — and podcasts: California Rebel Base, The Steve Hilton Show, Big Ideas Book Club. Through my policy organization, Golden Together, I’ve set out the changes we need to make to get this state back on track. Over the last few years, I’ve traveled the state, meeting people from all walks of life and backgrounds, in every part of California. I’ve spent time with business owners and workers in every industry, struggling with the absolute nightmare it’s become to start and grow a company here. I’ve seen the struggles so many Californians face raising a family given the unbelievable costs of living here. To make real change happen in government, you need the ability to think differently, the courage to challenge establishment groupthink and the conviction to follow through. That’s what I will bring to this job – to the urgent necessity of restoring the California Dream for everyone, and making this beautiful state, that we love so much, truly Golden Again. | | | | | | ---|---|--- PAID FOR BY STEVE HILTON FOR GOVERNOR 2026 FPPC ID#1480425 Please add mailto:info@stevehiltonforgovernor.com "info@stevegarvey.com" to your email contacts to make sure our updates are making it into your inbox. Politicians in DC are running up our debt, ripping away our health care, disrespecting our veterans, cutting help for the poor and putting our Medicare at risk — just to give tax breaks to the very rich. **I’ve had enough.**

Will you split a contribution of $20 or another amount that’s right for you between my campaign and Long Run PAC to get us started off strong**_**?**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/4261?t=2&akid=5582%2E196590%2EJb7p6s)

clean_body: | This is deeply personal to me, Peter. I’m running for Congress for families like mine. My mom worked as a public school employee, and my dad was a small business owner in the Chino Valley. = My life changed forever when my dad was diagnosed with Hodgkin's lymphoma. My childhood memories were of waiting in hospital rooms, watching my parents try to hold everything together for my sake. He passed away when I was twelve. Then, it was just me and my mom. I know my story is similar to that of thousands of families across California and the country. It is part of what made Republicans passing the so-called “Big Beautiful Bill” so devastating. It is not an exaggeration to say that without health insurance, I would not have had as much time with my dad. Everyone deserves quality healthcare. Full stop. That is the future Republicans, especially my opponent Young Kim, have forced on families today. #

Peter, we’re approaching our next monthly deadline tomorrow. Hits at midnight.
That deadline comes at a moment unlike any other in our nation’s history.
I served in Iraq as a Marine at the height of the war, about 20 years ago. All those years ago, I never thought I’d see a president as lawless as this one. I never thought I’d see the President of the United States blatantly ignore the Supreme Court. I signed up to serve to defend our Constitution — to make sure exactly that kind of thing never happened at home.
This is authoritarianism. It is here. And we need to stand up now or risk losing the rights and liberties we were born with.
You know what’s happening, but most people still don’t. If we’re going to build a movement that stops and reverses Trump’s power grab, we have to start reaching people anywhere they are.
That’s why I’m getting on cable news all the time. It’s why I’m doing podcasts and social media, interviews with local and national papers. It’s why I’m doing town halls all over the country, and why I hope to do more soon.
That’s what I did in my campaign. It’s what I’ve been doing since I got elected. And I’m going to keep doing it as long as I have to until we start to break through to people.

The history of the Roman Republic is a captivating tale of achievement, political and military genius, and the perils of success. One that still impacts our world today.

To help tell this important story to Americans nationwide, we released our free online course, **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic."**

**You can now receive your own DVD box set of "The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic" when you make a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**

And, for a limited time, we'll also send you a **free color map** of the Roman world at the end of the Republic. This map is a helpful companion to the course DVD and will illustrate many of the topics discussed in the lectures.
Simply use this secure link to reserve your DVD box set of **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic," **along with the companion map today:

[**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/roman-republic-dvd**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=fed42e908a2a4625b84c6379d1a85e8b&_e=DeFxZlLxja_Sz5NnDaffkZtYENGyD_e-ujZp5yXLlN7XwfW3wPyBz1nVEXhS0-_8bW9muLMFdSfc0Kixf94xRUSQTT6YM2XLCmtxVSN_4rnepV5KgoDNA6kiV55aXD3TNSPIEbxEBRy3QFyd2iKHvzXeOTLHQoI2zawgAn2r0wYUr4icFIOSHODMko9_fipA9-2u6Q6J8YMsVewR4MW5Nqgh8dUh521rS9jcN0sLSakx6USEGNJ83wdewf9tMl5IgeB3fmzpH1BPYaFysEJ9vEVuUeUww2_wkU3yFPbMBichRo7oeFX836DOtl6fPu5gj7yOtuRqYIslesL2Mno0bl3D1ak-LIBwaL7x6pvEz2eV_k7q7AwcTrTksNwckbE5XNyZ5OVDxC4SaJNnQpIYQwsNAxOAQ6BeldN1SuuG_H55PpAV9YUGFF43qdnszebDZibydrhkVp7uUa-c_JeT0Fg-CizF1f7IrWf_Zry6T3vUt39iusuhGxO1KPFbAaT3dpNEqng5JlqZooLNpBD48ZJowNc6v0LlwjCK3aJKv1UbjwhTM3h6C3KSawJjTgdTLw_0V-mqHLiFcguO3nwiB1k4y_35vq9NmZJf7g68NJh4fqqGal4TYTUZ6ZdDaXBfmHx6NLyvBJihSZLhtPp4Im7c2jwoUFO_Uay1fyn47QhAfmVmbbctG5UdpryM58yZ0R-w9YR_Gi-nfRztg0nrh7xVeDxBJChVrfxtORNISe4%3D)

By studying ancient Rome, you'll discover the conditions necessary to preserve a republic, and, conversely, how a republic may lose its way.

That's why we produced **" The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic"** and why I hope you'll watch and share the course on DVD.

Thank you for helping to preserve liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Best regards,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.

| | The controversy over the Trump administration's refusal to release the files on Jeffrey Epstein has reached a fever pitch. **The American people deserve transparency, and I am continuing to urge the DOJ to investigate financial information regarding Epstein's network that**** _I know_****they have access to.** **** For over three years, my staff and I have been investigating the paper trail between wealthy individuals funding Epstein's sex trafficking operation. That includes digging into records of banks that helped enable him get away with his crimes. My staff and I recently released more findings in our investigation that show over 4,700 wire transfers and nearly $1.1 BILLION flowing through just one bank account. With hundreds of millions more flowing through others, including sanctioned Russian banks. Attorney General Pam Bondi claims there's nothing to investigate. If you ask me, that's over 4700 lines of investigation right there to start with. My message to everyone tracking this is that investigators need to **follow the money.** However, the longer Trump and Bondi keep shifting their answers and taking contradictory actions to their past promises to release the files, which Trump campaigned on, the more questions everyone has. The longer he stonewalls, the clearer it becomes that there's something to hide. Meanwhile, House Republicans left town early for a 1.5-month vacation so they didn't have to face votes on releasing the files. Republicans are literally running away from exposing the truth. What are they trying to hide? Donald Trump campaigned on being the most transparent president in history. He campaigned on lowering costs. He campaigned on releasing the Epstein files. Just like every other promise he's made to the American people – this one is being broken. I'm tired of seeing powerful people obscure, lie, and hide in order to protect other powerful people. **When elites seem afraid of the truth, it's all the more reason to let the truth out.** At the end of the day, this is about basic trust. Because if the White House can't tell us what should be easy-to-understand facts about the Epstein files, what else are they hiding? Onward, for the truth. _Ron_

clean_body: | | | | The controversy over the Trump administration's refusal to release the files on Jeffrey Epstein has reached a fever pitch. The American people deserve transparency, and I am continuing to urge the DOJ to investigate financial information regarding Epstein's network that I knowthey have access to. ** For over three years, my staff and I have been investigating the paper trail between wealthy individuals funding Epstein's sex trafficking operation. That includes digging into records of banks that helped enable him get away with his crimes. My staff and I recently released more findings in our investigation that show over 4,700 wire transfers and nearly $1.1 BILLION flowing through just one bank account. With hundreds of millions more flowing through others, including sanctioned Russian banks. Attorney General Pam Bondi claims there's nothing to investigate. If you ask me, that's over 4700 lines of investigation right there to start with. My message to everyone tracking this is that investigators need to follow the money. However, the longer Trump and Bondi keep shifting their answers and taking contradictory actions to their past promises to release the files, which Trump campaigned on, the more questions everyone has. The longer he stonewalls, the clearer it becomes that there's something to hide. Meanwhile, House Republicans left town early for a 1.5-month vacation so they didn't have to face votes on releasing the files. Republicans are literally running away from exposing the truth. What are they trying to hide? Donald Trump campaigned on being the most transparent president in history. He campaigned on lowering costs. He campaigned on releasing the Epstein files. Just like every other promise he's made to the American people – this one is being broken. I'm tired of seeing powerful people obscure, lie, and hide in order to protect other powerful people. When elites seem afraid of the truth, it's all the more reason to let the truth out. At the end of the day, this is about basic trust. Because if the White House can't tell us what should be easy-to-understand facts about the Epstein files, what else are they hiding? Onward, for the truth. | | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.

friend,
---
I was retained as President Trump’s lawyer shortly after he was wrongly accused of being a Russian agent.
---
Thank God the truth came out, and the President walked free.
---
But now we know the _full story_. Newly DECLASSIFIED evidence alleges that my former client was FRAMED...
---
Director of National Intelligence Report: “Declassified Evidence of Obama Administration Conspiracy to Subvert President Trump’s 2016 Victory and Presidency”
---
Imagine if they got away with it. Imagine if President Trump were sitting in prison as an innocent man – and not because of a mistake, but because of a _set-up_ ...
---
As a lifelong prosecutor, that makes me sick to my stomach.
---
I spent my career obsessing over one thing: ensuring those I prosecuted were _truly_ guilty. I NEVER wanted to look back and think I took away liberty from an innocent man – and God forbid, his _life_.
---
**But unfortunately, that may soon be __my own fate__.**
---
**A Democrat Attorney General is making me stand in a rigged trial as an innocent man for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
And the judge presiding over my case was appointed by _Obama’s_ former Homeland Security Secretary! _It’s rigged from start to finish!_
---
_Democrats couldn’t take down President Trump. So now, they’re calling for the head of the man who helped him walk free._
---
**The Left wants me to be their sacrificial lamb.**
---
_But I’m not going to roll over and surrender. I’m going to recall those powerful words of our President and _fight, fight, fight!__
---
While the most powerful man in the country legally cannot step in to save me, the most powerful _force_ absolutely can: _THE AMERICAN PEOPLE_.
---
**That’s why I’m humbly asking YOU to fight for my freedom and justice.**
---
My mugshot was entered under booking #2313757, so my goal is for 2,313,757 patriots to sign my official petition — [**“THE PEOPLE’S PARDON”**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.)— calling for my freedom and to DROP ALL CHARGES.

_Thanks to so many kind souls, we’re closing in on our signature goal! I hope you’ll sign to push us over the top._

Friend, we just marked six months since Donald Trump began his second term. I know ... it’s felt like even longer to me, too.
These six months haven’t just been filled with chaos. They’ve been filled with a cruel, disastrous, and extreme agenda that is directly harming the American people.
Donald Trump has signed the biggest health care cut in U.S. history into law as part of his budget bill, which will rob millions of health care and send health insurance premiums skyrocketing for virtually every American – all while giving billionaires a tax break.
He is doubling down on his reckless tariffs, making your life more expensive for no reason whatsoever.
His administration is working to slash funding for everything from disaster response to _PBS_. That’s right, they’re trying to defund Sesame Street.
The list goes on and on.
**Republicans in Congress have been rubber-stamping this reckless and historically unpopular agenda every step of the way. Local elections set the tone for entire states — and the country. If we want real change, we have to fight for it, city by city. | | | Peter, Just a few weeks ago, Zohran Mamdani shocked the political establishment — not just in New York City, but across the country. He defeated a former governor backed by corporate donors and billionaires, and won his Democratic primary for Mayor with a bold platform rooted in working-class values like free public transit, rent freezes, and taxing the rich to invest in care and community. This may have been a political earthquake. But it wasn’t a fluke. It was the result of working people coming together across their city to demand more from their government — and then organizing to win it. **Right now we’re throwing down in local races across the country with a chance to elect more WFP champions to local office, and we need your help to keep the momentum going.** Some primaries are coming up next week in **Seattle** and **Detroit** , and our candidates are ready to flip the script on politics-as-usual. They’re renters, transit-riders, neighborhood caretakers, and lifelong fighters grounded in their communities — not beholden to powerful interests. [**Donate now to this slate of WFP champions and help power the next wave of wins for working families in next week’s primaries.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9YLypNO8Qxxnwstu0rGK4IOI2lABaRDv72A6DPubb60IpYI9kuY2KlP2AFfLyPWYdzPfgfimnGo22hIizYNNoBYVw5QvPGw2XaWxalrHC7VSmXC_luYAsIBAdReyHsQQUudSEUSM3TMyDKb6yZ9ew-yw40gxJfyj68trH2itHx3Nkdg-gxLvq7hQIe4_aRoUCH3xZm2VDiIJt-rVbvhhN75hOFn-JfW74yFJlb_oDkGvz4Uk6b-Lv4greue-8VCj8TruQOeWXOed-D51hYxMk8rG1QFaWhCS5auc7H9x5-K3UDpzE8OwoJL8Ft7q5RSrzQ8Q6cLyGK6vsbN4c6yxcoA/4im/hsVIPYRyQ4-r5HVKBywEcg/h0/h001.ZFWvBh9QjJlUZ6jRJnQLS00fdVM2FtFS_N1A_dQ9G7I) **[Donate now »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9YLypNO8Qxxnwstu0rGK4IOI2lABaRDv72A6DPubb60IpYI9kuY2KlP2AFfLyPWYdl12RtY89jk-YCr-y_s3PoAhjqVX26q7j8wmYlnCyRx1J3tc4JTPd8v1Q078JxsbTGPm4y3vrV7uJtScs1QG2ipHjhHk8FBNjbIyeIxFbvovOHwQvfM1ZkFJ3pPgGpo9xP2DNB9gKiKhi5nadADiwxpX8wUr2juxTPvuqWpe9kXTT_APaejc6KUO9eb1h-DR8sEgQ-_RKBYGg9TEDivo_nDq7PE9NT6rFi6SI0RWH4ny4Tu5mfAzoO60uwdSaYJnZw9hFZigSWxjVKpY2g09C9w/4im/hsVIPYRyQ4-r5HVKBywEcg/h1/h001.9qvrnS6CCbXOD3ul7Aa7KL5ySIzrhNgymhgYqkdURJE)** In**Seattle** , we’re backing three champions for City Council who know what it’s like to struggle — and who never gave up: **🌟 Alexis Mercedes Rinck** Alexis was raised by her grandparents after her teenage parents faced instability, incarceration, and homelessness. She’s been through it — and she knows the difference it makes when communities invest in their young people. She worked restaurant jobs to pay her way through college, then became a fierce advocate for reproductive rights, climate justice, and corporate accountability. Today, she’s a renter, a transit rider, and a policy expert focused on building a city where _everyone_ can thrive, not just survive. **🌟Dionne Foster** Dionne started working two jobs in high school to help her single mom — a veteran and public school teacher — make ends meet. She waited tables while putting herself through college and earned a master’s in social work. She knows firsthand how hard families are working just to survive. And she’s used every role she’s held — in nonprofits, philanthropy, and government — to fight for better housing, stronger labor protections, and a real safety net. She’s a mom, a home gardener, and a local food bank volunteer. A proud WNBA fan. And the kind of leader who wants to move past divisive politics and focus on what really matters: making life better for working people. **🌟Katie Wilson** Katie Wilson moved to Seattle in 2004 and worked every job under the sun — barista, boatyard laborer, apartment manager — just to get by. Then she started organizing. As co-founder of the Transit Riders Union, she’s spent over a decade winning real change: higher wages, stronger renter protections, and more affordable housing. Now she’s running for mayor on a bold platform: housing for all, world-class public transit, and real solutions to homelessness. She’s a mom, a bus rider, and a coalition-builder ready to deliver for working people. In **Detroit** , we’re behind two candidates for City Council who’ve stayed rooted in their communities — and who refuse to give up on building a better city for working people: **🌟Gabriela Santiago-Romero** An immigrant, organizer, and proven leader, Gabriela has already done what other politicians promised for decades but never delivered. In her first term on City Council, she secured $1 million to make streets and sidewalks safer in Detroit’s most neglected neighborhoods and helped Detroiters become homeowners through the Down Payment Assistance program. She doesn’t take corporate PAC money. She governs with transparency. And she’s focused on real results — because that’s what her community deserves. **🌟Denzel Anton McCampbell** Denzel is a lifelong Detroiter raised on the city’s east side. His parents taught him to show up, speak out, and fight for others — and he’s done just that for over a decade. He’s fought for voting rights, clean water, racial justice, public safety, and campaign finance reform. He served as a charter commissioner, rewriting Detroit’s constitution to center equity, and worked as a communications director to Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib. Now he’s running to bring that same relentless commitment to working people to the City Council — so city services actually work, developers don’t call the shots, and residents finally get the representation they deserve. **These are the leaders we need right now, Peter. Not just in Seattle. Not just in Detroit. Everywhere.** Across the country, working families are facing rising costs, housing insecurity, broken transit systems, and political leadership that’s more interested in protecting the status quo than transforming it. That’s why the Working Families Party is organizing to elect a new generation of leaders — people like Gabriela, Denzel, Alexis, and Dionne — who carry the fight for us. But building this movement takes all of us. **Local elections set the tone for entire states — and the country. If we want real change, we have to fight for it, city by city.**[**Donate now to help elect****these****bold, working-class champions****—****and****help us****build power nationwide.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9YLypNO8Qxxnwstu0rGK4IOI2lABaRDv72A6DPubb60IpYI9kuY2KlP2AFfLyPWYdqkEIlDu92dlpNnWU6h_YAvS9viprjEqmqf5DY6oA459tjGkxBsX3Ps1fMVihjk7oWJe9zqfXLfq9GB8XxD2DfMrLH4qCw-T2VpnAViiEtjwKoKwHODpeuLEi62dtwEKJ-r1fU3LwK5P2qYdJs6p1wPRN8nJaCQGZVl4Iec3fiycOmYSNnVoSbpS3B5nC78YohK7wq6j10ri3mOPo5SiNyPij_Eyc8KyL6brz3WThVjiyaCTul3yKxw65KUzmt4Gu-5eIMMvrFu8irEoMCFng1w/4im/hsVIPYRyQ4-r5HVKBywEcg/h2/h001.VtdKD_XTLez5jTuS8nfb6L26gKLl3u4hWHYABtpruQ8) **[Donate now »](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9YLypNO8Qxxnwstu0rGK4IOI2lABaRDv72A6DPubb60IpYI9kuY2KlP2AFfLyPWYdJ_0wd-cWc0icq-k4bkjIg4FyynYDn7Y3PRXiukzNuxkXnuxIA02VmBQyVq3xf4L47USs7TV_hcxnHtN6xJJtefkxnQqGdmSvGQFmkgvn258nue5akbbC3B3_UMyCUJ9DfpZ3joomo60F1fLoZ8Y1J1UA2IdJRpYXnTeJFVvpf0Tze7vZzOqtwEm9jHnxZsbgGr2Qq7rn6s6du5GprImlM8mTBAaZdRhr8qdZYNDM6u2769H0pF-UEf6OZKeoPOUPwQUmvgnTKzzIhcyZoJqWqA/4im/hsVIPYRyQ4-r5HVKBywEcg/h3/h001.BjKnN8REYHmb_aQ_c5WtpBJL6CEsOgRFu8aiDX517m4)** We don’t have billionaires. clean_body: Local elections set the tone for entire states — and the country. If we want real change, we have to fight for it, city by city. | | | Peter, Just a few weeks ago, Zohran Mamdani shocked the political establishment — not just in New York City, but across the country. He defeated a former governor backed by corporate donors and billionaires, and won his Democratic primary for Mayor with a bold platform rooted in working-class values like free public transit, rent freezes, and taxing the rich to invest in care and community. This may have been a political earthquake. But it wasn’t a fluke. It was the result of working people coming together across their city to demand more from their government — and then organizing to win it. Right now we’re throwing down in local races across the country with a chance to elect more WFP champions to local office, and we need your help to keep the momentum going. Some primaries are coming up next week in Seattle and Detroit , and our candidates are ready to flip the script on politics-as-usual. They’re renters, transit-riders, neighborhood caretakers, and lifelong fighters grounded in their communities — not beholden to powerful interests. InSeattle , we’re backing three champions for City Council who know what it’s like to struggle — and who never gave up: 🌟 Alexis Mercedes Rinck Alexis was raised by her grandparents after her teenage parents faced instability, incarceration, and homelessness. She’s been through it — and she knows the difference it makes when communities invest in their young people. She worked restaurant jobs to pay her way through college, then became a fierce advocate for reproductive rights, climate justice, and corporate accountability. Today, she’s a renter, a transit rider, and a policy expert focused on building a city where everyone can thrive, not just survive. 🌟Dionne Foster Dionne started working two jobs in high school to help her single mom — a veteran and public school teacher — make ends meet. She waited tables while putting herself through college and earned a master’s in social work. She knows firsthand how hard families are working just to survive. And she’s used every role she’s held — in nonprofits, philanthropy, and government — to fight for better housing, stronger labor protections, and a real safety net. She’s a mom, a home gardener, and a local food bank volunteer. A proud WNBA fan. And the kind of leader who wants to move past divisive politics and focus on what really matters: making life better for working people. 🌟Katie Wilson Katie Wilson moved to Seattle in 2004 and worked every job under the sun — barista, boatyard laborer, apartment manager — just to get by. Then she started organizing. As co-founder of the Transit Riders Union, she’s spent over a decade winning real change: higher wages, stronger renter protections, and more affordable housing. Now she’s running for mayor on a bold platform: housing for all, world-class public transit, and real solutions to homelessness. She’s a mom, a bus rider, and a coalition-builder ready to deliver for working people. In Detroit , we’re behind two candidates for City Council who’ve stayed rooted in their communities — and who refuse to give up on building a better city for working people: 🌟Gabriela Santiago-Romero An immigrant, organizer, and proven leader, Gabriela has already done what other politicians promised for decades but never delivered. In her first term on City Council, she secured $1 million to make streets and sidewalks safer in Detroit’s most neglected neighborhoods and helped Detroiters become homeowners through the Down Payment Assistance program. She doesn’t take corporate PAC money. She governs with transparency. And she’s focused on real results — because that’s what her community deserves. 🌟Denzel Anton McCampbell Denzel is a lifelong Detroiter raised on the city’s east side. His parents taught him to show up, speak out, and fight for others — and he’s done just that for over a decade. He’s fought for voting rights, clean water, racial justice, public safety, and campaign finance reform. He served as a charter commissioner, rewriting Detroit’s constitution to center equity, and worked as a communications director to Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib. Now he’s running to bring that same relentless commitment to working people to the City Council — so city services actually work, developers don’t call the shots, and residents finally get the representation they deserve. These are the leaders we need right now, Peter. Not just in Seattle. Not just in Detroit. Everywhere. Across the country, working families are facing rising costs, housing insecurity, broken transit systems, and political leadership that’s more interested in protecting the status quo than transforming it. That’s why the Working Families Party is organizing to elect a new generation of leaders — people like Gabriela, Denzel, Alexis, and Dionne — who carry the fight for us. But building this movement takes all of us. Local elections set the tone for entire states — and the country. If we want real change, we have to fight for it, city by city. We don’t have billionaires. We don’t take corporate cash. But we do have people. Lots of them. And when we come together, when we organize, support each other, and vote: we win. We saw it in New York. Now let’s do it again — and again — and again. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. Reply directly to this email and let us know. body:
I’ll keep up this work — no matter how many Wawa runs it takes.
#
If you follow me on social media or read many of our emails, you probably know that I absolutely love coffee. **Especially when it comes from Wawa (sorry, not sorry Sheetz)!**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250730-1?refcode=em20250730-2227&amount=5&refcode2=2227_21716_5KxHHX&akid=2227%2E21716%2E5KxHHX)
While I take a quick coffee break, I wanted to reach out about something important:**we’re closing in on our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and it’s a big one.** And in addition to the coffee, I’m counting on your grassroots support to keep fueling this fight.
Because while folks keep asking me about cream and sugar, they're also talking about the real issues — like how to bring down the cost of housing and groceries, how to make childcare more affordable, and how to visit the doctor without breaking the bank. They want to know someone is fighting for them, as Donald Trump and corrupt DC Republicans rip us off and pad the pockets of billionaires.
That’s what I’m focused on every day in Congress. I’m showing up, speaking out, and fighting to make sure my neighbors and working families everywhere have a fair shot — no matter how many Wawa runs it takes!
**But here’s the truth: 2026 is around the corner. Hitting our fundraising goals is essential to help me stay in Congress and build the coalition we need to take back the House.**
[**So if you’re with me, will you pitch in $5 or more before Thursday’s fundraising deadline?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250730-1?refcode=em20250730-2227&amount=5&refcode2=2227_21716_5KxHHX&akid=2227%2E21716%2E5KxHHX)
Thank you so much,

Especially when it comes from Wawa (sorry, not sorry Sheetz)! While I take a quick coffee break, I wanted to reach out about something important:we’re closing in on our end-of-month fundraising deadline, and it’s a big one. And in addition to the coffee, I’m counting on your grassroots support to keep fueling this fight. Because while folks keep asking me about cream and sugar, they're also talking about the real issues — like how to bring down the cost of housing and groceries, how to make childcare more affordable, and how to visit the doctor without breaking the bank. They want to know someone is fighting for them, as Donald Trump and corrupt DC Republicans rip us off and pad the pockets of billionaires. That’s what I’m focused on every day in Congress. I’m showing up, speaking out, and fighting to make sure my neighbors and working families everywhere have a fair shot — no matter how many Wawa runs it takes! But here’s the truth: 2026 is around the corner. Hitting our fundraising goals is essential to help me stay in Congress and build the coalition we need to take back the House. Thank you so much, Sarah

I ran for Congress in part because Donald Trump and my Republican representative attempted to repeal the Affordable Care Act. Now, Republicans in Washington have voted to rip away healthcare from 320,000+ Virginians, raise premiums for working families, and threaten the closure of our rural hospitals. I couldn't sit on the sidelines then, and I won't today. Not when my opponent, Winsome Earle-Sears, is cheering on this attack on Virginia families. My promise to you in this campaign is the same promise I've always made: to put Virginians first. That's what I'm doing as I travel the Commonwealth and hear from people on these issues. [1]Powered By People

Today, Texas House Republicans unveiled a proposed congressional map
designed to take five Democratic seats and lock in GOP dominance through
the 2026 midterm elections.

This isn’t just another redistricting process. It’s a mid-decade power
grab—engineered by Trump and Abbott to target Democratic members of
Congress and redraw the lines in Austin, Dallas, Houston, and South
Texas—rigging the outcome before voters even have a say.^1

Trump and Abbott know that without these five seats, Republicans could
lose their grip on the House. And by packing Democratic voters into fewer
districts while spreading Republican voters across Democratic districts,
they’re hoping to dilute our power and silence our voices.^2

But we’re not just going to fight this—we’re going to fight through this.

We’re getting off the back foot, moving from defense to offense, and
taking this fight to every single county in Texas and every state in the
union. That means reaching, registering, and turning out likely Democratic
voters so that we are prepared to win not just these newly proposed
districts, but also flip old Republican districts too.

But this kind of ground game takes serious resources, and that’s why I’m

| | Peter – It’s been nearly 4 weeks since the House Majority passed its reckless, misguided budget bill. As our communities brace for its impacts, we’re seeing what happens when hyperpartisanship and special interests hold the reins in Congress:
| **_OPB:_**
_**Small Washington hospitals brace for ‘severe’ effects of Medicaid cuts**
“As many as 250,000 residents could lose Medicaid coverage in Washington. That reduction would mean fewer patients can pay at hospitals that are already struggling.”_
---

As we recognize the 60th anniversary of Medicaid being signed into law, I’m making sure we stay focused on what’s really important to working families, and telling the Majority to reassess its priorities.

Instead of middle-class tax cuts, Medicaid protections, or cost-saving measures – you know, things that actually help working families – this budget saddles our kids with $4 trillion in debt to pay for tax giveaways for the top 0.1%.

Frankly, it’s ridiculous. This is why I fight. If we don’t protect seats like ours and flip the House next year, we’re in store for more special favors for special interests while everyday Americans are left carrying the bag.

Derek, If your inbox looks anything like ours, it’s absolutely stuffed with fundraising requests from candidates and organizations making last-minute requests to donate before our upcoming end-of-month fundraising deadline. We hope you’ll give us a minute to explain why a well-timed donation to the Democratic National Committee is the best choice for those looking to make a difference in this moment. The work to win back Congress and ultimately, the White House, has to start _right now._ Here’s the truth: Donald Trump and congressional Republicans just passed a massively unpopular budget that slashes health care for people all over the country, while billionaires get a giant handout. Trump’s chaotic trade war has made prices soar. And as a cherry on top, Trump has now spent weeks trying to distract us from his administration’s refusal to release the Epstein files instead of being transparent with the American people. **None of this is normal, Derek.** But we’re not powerless, and together we can chart a new path. Millions of Americans voted against Trump and his allies in the last election, and we’re not going to sit idly by while this administration continues to wreak havoc on our country. Democrats are organizing. We’re showing up at town halls and at the ballot box. We’re focused on the work ahead: **electing Democrats who will check Trump’s power. To do that, we need your help.** **[The DNC is the organization best positioned to move resources to the places they’re needed most, this year and beyond.
